raw.description:
Omada Health is on a mission to bend the curve of chronic disease.

Job overview:

Omada is hiring a Customer Experience Enablement Senior Manager to strengthen how Customer Success Managers (CSMs) show up in front of customers, customized to their size and service level. This role is responsible for translating CX goals, field feedback, and business priorities into enablement strategy, high-value resources, and scalable systems that improve effectiveness in client-facing work.

Approximately half of the role should focus on strategic enablement: identifying the highest-leverage opportunities to improve CX effectiveness, shaping priorities and narratives, and ensuring enablement efforts directly support how CSMs manage and grow their books of business. The other half of the role should focus on scaling core enablement operations through systems thinking, process design, and AI-enabled workflows. This includes improving and modernizing foundational enablement infrastructure such as knowledge management, team communications, enablement intake, resource discoverability, and self-serve support so that the function scales efficiently without relying on high-touch project management.

About you:

You are an experienced enablement leader who uses customer and CSM feedback to identify the highest‑leverage priorities and adjust them as business needs evolve. You have a strong track record of applying AI and automation to reduce manual work, improve scale, and free up time for more strategic enablement. You thrive in highly collaborative, cross‑functional environments and are effective at influencing stakeholders across teams. You have successfully enabled customer‑facing teams that support multiple complex products, navigate varied rules of engagement, and serve diverse buyer types across the customer lifecycle.

Your impact:

  • Own a clear enablement roadmap tied to CX goals, team effectiveness, and customer-facing outcomes.
  • Translate CSM pain points, voice of customer themes, and business priorities into actionable enablement strategies, tools, narratives, and guidance.
  • Partner with PMM, Clinical, Product, Analytics, Client Operations, and CX leadership to identify where enablement can most directly improve customer conversations, book management, retention, and growth.
  • Shape strategic content and frameworks that help CSMs communicate value consistently and confidently across the customer journey.
  • Bring a clear point of view on what work should be prioritized, deprioritized, automated, or transitioned in order to keep the function focused on high-impact enablement.
  • Define success measures for enablement work and use feedback, usage patterns, and business context to continuously refine priorities.
  • Identify opportunities to use AI and automation to reduce low-value manual work across knowledge management, communications, intake triage, recurring content updates, and resource maintenance.
  • Create self-serve tools, repeatable workflows, and clear decision pathways so CX teammates can more easily find answers, access resources, and understand what matters most.

Evaluation Criteria:

  • 6–8+ years of customer success enablement, sales/revenue enablement, customer success operations, or related experience, with deeper experience in enablement than in general project management.
  • Proven ability to break down ambiguous business problems into clear priorities, practical solutions, and scalable enablement strategies.
  • Demonstrated success translating customer, CSM, and business feedback into roadmaps, resources, and guidance that improve field effectiveness.
  • Strong ownership mindset with the ability to operate autonomously and balance strategic thinking with operational execution in a fast-paced environment.
  • Clear communicator with strong professional presence, listening skills, and the ability to influence cross-functional stakeholders and senior leaders.
  • Experience using AI, automation, or systems thinking to reduce manual work, improve scale, and increase team efficiency.

You will love this job if you:

  • Have successfully enabled teams working across multiple complex products, varied rules of engagement, and different buyer types.
  • Enjoy turning ambiguity into structure, strategy, and practical guidance
  • Are energized by using AI or automation to streamline repetitive work and create more space for strategic impact.
  • Enjoy highly collaborative, cross-functional work and are effective at partnering with leaders across functions.
  • Have a background or interest in health technology, digital health, or telemedicine.
  • Have strong written and verbal communication skills and can simplify complex information for busy teams.

Benefits:

  • Competitive salary with generous annual cash bonus
  • Equity grants
  • Employee stock purchasing plan (ESPP)
  • Remote first work from home culture
  • Flexible Time Off to help you rest, recharge, and connect with loved ones
  • Generous parental leave
  • Health, dental, and vision insurance (and above market employer contributions)
  • 401k retirement savings plan
  • Lifestyle Spending Account (LSA)
  • Mental Health Support Solutions
  • ...and more!

It takes a village to change health care. As we build together toward our mission, we strive to embody the following values in our day-to-day work. We hope these hold meaning for you as well as you consider Omada!

  • Cultivate Trust. We listen closely and we operate with kindness. We provide respectful and candid feedback to each other.
  • Seek Context. We ask to understand and we build connections. We do our research up front to move faster down the road.
  • Act Boldly. We innovate daily to solve problems, improve processes, and find new opportunities for our members and customers.
  • Deliver Results. We reward impact above output. We set a high bar, we’re not afraid to fail, and we take pride in our work.
  • Succeed Together. We prioritize Omada’s progress above team or individual. We have fun as we get stuff done, and we celebrate together.
  • Remember Why We’re Here. We push through the challenges of changing health care because we know the destination is worth it.

About Omada Health: Omada Health (Nasdaq: OMDA) is reverse engineering the way healthcare is delivered in America, putting the space between doctor visits–where health is won or lost–at the center of care. Today's healthcare system poorly serves chronic conditions that require ongoing support outside of the exam room, like obesity, diabetes, hypertension, cholesterol, and musculoskeletal conditions. Omada’s virtual-first model combines human-led care teams, connected devices, and AI-enabled technology to deliver personalized care at scale, including support for GLP-1 therapy. Omada has served more than two million members since launch across 2,000+ employers, health plans, pharmacy benefit managers, and health systems. Learn more at omadahealth.com.

Omada is thrilled to share that we’ve been certified as a Great Place to Work! Please click here for more information.

We carefully hire the best talent we can find, which means actively seeking diversity of beliefs, backgrounds, education, and ways of thinking. We strive to build an inclusive culture where differences are celebrated and leveraged to inform better design and business decisions. Omada is proud to be an equal opportunity workplace and affirmative action employer. We are committed to equal opportunity regardless of race, color, religion, sex, gender identity, national origin, ancestry, citizenship, age, physical or mental disability, legally protected medical condition, family care status, military or veteran status, marital status, domestic partner status, sexual orientation, or any other basis protected by local, state, or federal laws. Pursuant to the San Francisco Fair Chance Ordinance, we will consider for employment qualified applicants with arrest and conviction records.

Below is a summary of salary ranges, by geographic zone, for this role*. These ranges represent a good faith estimate of the minimum and maximum base salary for the position in that zone at the time of posting. Please refer to thisresource for detail on zone designations.

Please note that zones may be updated as market data changes but we will honor the range applicable to your zone (which is determined by your location) as of your application date.

*The actual offer, including the compensation package, will be within the posted range for the relevant zone and will be determined based on multiple factors, such as the candidate's skills and experience, and other business considerations such as internal equity.

raw.description:
With a career at The Home Depot, you can be yourself and also be part of something bigger.

Position Purpose:

The Virtual Support Specialist Millwork - (Remote) is part of the Services Operations Contact Center team. The Virtual Apron Team has the ability to engage and support customers on-line, in home, and in the store virtually. The Virtual Support Specialist is responsible for providing tailored suggestions and solutions through consultative selling that inspire our customers. The Virtual Support Specialist builds and maintains customer relationships, assisting associates and customers during sales and product inquiries. In this role, the specialist provides dedicated support for the Millwork Line of Business, assisting customers with door and window solutions, product customization, and project inquiries specific to Millwork. The specialist qualifies new customers seeking to customize Millwork products, generates new leads, and warm transfers them to a Virtual Design Specialist for further consultation and design support. The Virtual Apron Support Specialist will also assist customers with the following: leverage the online configurator tool, general inquiries, order status, following up with vendors and stores on customer projects, making outbound calls to follow up on online requests and in-store leads, obtaining payment.

What Is Virtual Apron?

The Virtual Apron is an innovative, multi-team organization within The Home Depot that provides remote support to both online and in-store customers for their project needs. Virtual Apron associates are subject matter experts across a wide range of categories—including flooring, millwork, countertops, kitchen, bath, closet design, and installation services.

By leveraging deep product and process expertise, Virtual Apron associates help customers and store teams navigate both simple and complex orders. This remote support model ensures consistent, high-quality customer experience while enhancing operational efficiency across The Home Depot.

Key Responsibilities:

  • 40% - Customer Service - Facilitating inbound calls, qualifying customers, warm transferring to the appropriate teams, Online Configurator Tool assistance

  • 30% - Sell - Drive sales through consultative selling, contribute to personal and team sales goals while engaging customers in a professional manner via phone and/or online.

  • 20% - Support - Follow-up with vendors and stores on customer projects to help expedite and communicate timelines

  • 10% - Other - Job duties as assigned by the manager

Direct Manager/Direct Reports:

  • This Position typically reports to the Contact Center Supervisor

  • This Position has 0 Direct Reports

Travel Requirements:

  • Typically requires overnight travel less than 5% of the time.

Physical Requirements:

  • Most of the time is spent sitting in a comfortable position and there is frequent opportunity to move about. On rare occasions, there may be a need to move or lift light articles.

Working Conditions:

  • Located in a comfortable indoor area. Any unpleasant conditions would be infrequent and not objectionable.

Minimum Qualifications:

  • Must be 18 years of age or older

  • Must be legally permitted to work in the United States

Network Engineer – Remote

Position Type: Full-Time, Remote
Location: Remote
Working Hours: U.S. Business Hours (Flexibility required for on-call support and critical incidents)

About the Role

At Pavago, one of our clients is hiring a Network Engineer to design, maintain, secure, and optimize enterprise network infrastructure across client environments.

This is not a helpdesk or support-only role. You’ll take ownership of network reliability, performance, and security across enterprise environments while supporting both day-to-day operations and long-term infrastructure initiatives.

Working across routing, switching, firewalls, VPNs, monitoring systems, and hybrid cloud environments, you’ll ensure network infrastructure remains stable, secure, scalable, and highly available.

If you enjoy solving complex networking challenges, improving infrastructure, and maintaining mission-critical systems, this role is for you.

Responsibilities

Network Infrastructure & Configuration

  • Configure, maintain, and optimize enterprise network infrastructure, including routers, switches, firewalls, and VPNs.
  • Implement and manage:
    • VLANs
    • QoS
    • VPN tunnels
    • Access Control Lists (ACLs)
    • Routing protocols including OSPF, BGP, and EIGRP
  • Perform firmware upgrades, patching, and infrastructure maintenance.
  • Support network expansion projects, migrations, and infrastructure upgrades.
  • Maintain reliable connectivity across multi-site and hybrid environments.

Network Monitoring & Troubleshooting

  • Monitor network health using tools such as:
    • SolarWinds
    • PRTG
    • Nagios
    • Zabbix
  • Diagnose and resolve latency, packet loss, DNS, routing, and connectivity issues.
  • Troubleshoot escalated incidents using tools such as Wireshark and TCPdump.
  • Perform root-cause analysis and implement long-term preventive solutions.
  • Participate in on-call support and respond to critical network incidents when required.

Network Security & Compliance

  • Configure and maintain firewall environments including:
    • Cisco
    • Palo Alto
    • Fortinet
    • Juniper
  • Implement network segmentation, ACLs, and security policies.
  • Support compliance initiatives related to:
    • PCI-DSS
    • HIPAA
    • SOX
    • GDPR
  • Assist with Zero Trust networking and secure remote access implementations.
  • Maintain a secure, resilient, and well-governed network infrastructure.

Performance Optimization & Reliability

  • Perform bandwidth utilization analysis and capacity planning.
  • Optimize network performance through redundancy, failover, and load balancing.
  • Maintain high-availability infrastructure across enterprise environments.
  • Identify bottlenecks and recommend scalable infrastructure improvements.
  • Support cloud networking integrations across AWS, Azure, and hybrid environments.

Documentation & Operational Governance

  • Maintain accurate network diagrams, topology maps, SOPs, and technical documentation.
  • Document infrastructure changes following structured change management processes.
  • Keep configurations, procedures, and documentation organized and audit-ready.
  • Collaborate closely with infrastructure, cloud, security, and DevOps teams on network initiatives.

What Makes You a Great Fit

  • You have a strong troubleshooting mindset and remain calm during critical incidents.
  • You proactively identify and resolve infrastructure risks.
  • You communicate technical concepts clearly to both technical and non-technical stakeholders.
  • You maintain high standards for documentation and operational excellence.
  • You work independently while collaborating effectively within remote teams.
  • You take ownership of infrastructure reliability and long-term improvements.

Required Experience & Skills

  • 3+ years of professional Network Engineering experience.
  • Hands-on experience managing enterprise networking environments.
  • Strong knowledge of:
    • OSPF
    • BGP
    • EIGRP
  • Experience configuring:
    • Routers
    • Switches
    • Firewalls
    • VPN environments
  • Experience with network monitoring and troubleshooting platforms.
  • Strong experience with Cisco networking environments or equivalent enterprise platforms.
  • Solid understanding of:
    • TCP/IP
    • DNS
    • DHCP
    • VLANs
    • QoS
  • Excellent written and verbal English communication skills.

Preferred Experience

  • Cisco CCNA, CCNP, or equivalent certifications.
  • Experience with:
    • Palo Alto
    • Fortinet
    • Juniper
  • Experience supporting:
    • AWS VPCs
    • Azure VNets
    • Hybrid cloud networking
  • Familiarity with:
    • Python
    • Ansible
    • Terraform
  • Experience supporting multi-site enterprise environments.
  • Exposure to Zero Trust networking models and modern security frameworks.

What Success Looks Like

  • Network uptime consistently maintained at 99.9% or higher.
  • Fast resolution of network incidents and escalations.
  • Accurate, current, and well-maintained infrastructure documentation.
  • Timely completion of critical patches and compliance requirements.
  • Improved network stability, scalability, and performance.
  • Positive feedback from internal stakeholders on network reliability and support.

Interview Process

  • Initial Phone Screen
  • Video Interview with Pavago Recruiter
  • Technical Assessment (Network Troubleshooting or Configuration Exercise)
  • Client Interview with IT/Engineering Leadership
  • Offer & Background Verification

What Happens After You Apply

Right after you apply, you’ll receive an email invitation from Spark Hire to record your Intro Video. This short, self-recorded video is the final step that completes your application.

Instead of repeating yourself across multiple screening calls, you’ll introduce yourself once, and your video will be shared with the hiring team. This helps hiring managers evaluate your communication style early, making future interviews more meaningful while reducing unnecessary interview rounds.

Don’t overthink it—you can record your video as many times as you’d like before submitting it. Only your final submission will be reviewed. Please keep an eye on both your inbox and spam folder for your Spark Hire invitation.

Apply Now

If you’re a Network Engineer who enjoys designing resilient infrastructure, solving complex networking challenges, and maintaining secure, high-performing enterprise environments, we’d love to hear from you. Apply today and help build reliable network infrastructure that supports business growth and operational excellence.

raw.excerpt: About CapitexCapitex is a specialist contract and interim staffing firm focused exclusively on financial crime compliance.
raw.description:
About Capitex

Capitex is a specialist contract and interim staffing firm focused exclusively on financial crime compliance. We place experienced KYC, AML, sanctions, fraud and transaction monitoring professionals with banks, financial institutions and regulated firms across the United Kingdom, the United Arab Emirates and the United States.

Our clients come to us when they are under regulatory pressure and need vetted, capable people quickly — often within 24 to 48 hours. That speed only works because the administration behind it is precise. Since we were founded in 2021 we have built our reputation on exactly that combination.

We are a small, senior team. There are no layers to go through, decisions get made the same day, and the person doing a job is the person who owns it. It also means we hire carefully, because every person makes a visible difference.

The role

This role exists to take the operational running of our contractor and client administration off the desk of our CEO, so the business can grow without the back office becoming a bottleneck.

In practice, you are the person who makes sure nothing falls through the cracks. Contractors submit their timesheets because you chased them. Compliance files are complete because you collected the documents and followed up on what was missing. Our records are accurate because you keep them that way.

It is detailed, repetitive, deadline-driven work, and in our sector it genuinely matters. Our contractors work inside regulated financial institutions, which means their vetting and documentation have to be right — not roughly right. Getting that consistently correct is the core of this job.

You will report directly to our CEO and work alongside our two client-facing consultants.

What you will be doing

Timesheets and contractor administration

  • Chasing contractors and client managers for weekly and monthly timesheets across three regions
  • Collating approved timesheets and checking them against contract terms
  • Flagging discrepancies, missing approvals and anything that looks wrong
  • Preparing summary schedules for review and sign-off

Vetting, onboarding and documentation

  • Collecting onboarding documents from new contractors and following up on anything outstanding
  • Carrying out identity and right-to-work checks against a defined checklist
  • Requesting and chasing references, and recording the responses accurately
  • Maintaining complete, audit-ready compliance files for every contractor we place

Records, systems and coordination

  • Keeping contractor, client and placement records accurate and up to date
  • Maintaining our SharePoint and Teams file structure
  • Preparing invoice data for review, and issuing approved invoices
  • Liaising with Employer of Record providers on routine onboarding and document requests
  • Tracking key dates: contract end dates, document expiries, payment deadlines
  • Raising problems early rather than waiting to be asked

What this role is not

We think it is only fair to be clear about the boundaries, so you know exactly what you are taking on:

  • You will not authorise or release payments — that sits with our CEO
  • You will not set rates, margins or commercial terms
  • You will not handle escalated debt or difficult client conversations
  • You will not be doing business development or candidate sourcing

Hours and contract

Full time, approximately 10:00 to 18:30 SAST, aligned to UK business hours. Fully remote, based in South Africa. This role is offered on an initial six-month fixed-term contract through Capitex's UAE entity, with a formal review at the end of the term.

Where this can go

We are a growing business and this is our first operations hire. The role has been scoped so that someone who proves reliable on the fundamentals can take on more over time: ownership of invoicing, oversight of compliance, and eventually the wider operational running of the business as we expand across our three markets.

We would rather be honest than oversell. That progression depends on the business continuing to grow and on you demonstrating the accuracy the work demands. But the room is real, and there is no queue of people ahead of you.

How we hire

We keep it short and we give feedback at every stage.

  • Application review
  • A 30-minute introductory call
  • A short practical exercise using anonymised data: reconciling a batch of timesheets, spotting the errors, and drafting the follow-up emails. It takes around an hour.
  • A final interview with our CEO
  • References and offer

Requirements

This role is open to people early in their career. We care more about how you work than about how long you have been working.

Essential

  • One to three years in an administrative, bookkeeping, payroll or back-office support role
  • Genuine attention to detail — you notice when a number does not add up, and you check rather than assume
  • Clear, professional written English; you will be emailing our clients and contractors directly
  • Comfortable following up with people repeatedly and politely until you get what you need
  • Solid Excel skills and general confidence with software and online systems
  • Organised and self-directed — able to work a full day productively without being told what to do next
  • Discreet: you will handle confidential candidate, client and financial information every day

Helpful, but not required

  • Any exposure to recruitment, staffing, payroll or professional services
  • Any background in compliance, banking, financial services or vetting
  • Experience with Microsoft 365, SharePoint or Teams
  • Any experience working with clients or colleagues in another country

Practical requirements

  • Based in South Africa and able to work UK business hours
  • Reliable fibre internet with mobile data as a backup
  • Backup power — inverter, UPS or solar — sufficient to keep working through an outage
  • A quiet, private space to work from

Benefits

Real ownership from month one, not a queue of someone else's tasks

A direct line to the CEO — no layers, no politics, decisions made the same day

Fully remote

Exposure to financial crime compliance, a growing and well-paid specialism

Genuine room to grow as we expand across the UK, UAE and US

Have you caught yourself in the grocery store daydreaming about code… yeah, us too. At Fixify, we believe that technology is about more than code and algorithms — it's about enabling connections between people. That's why we're on a quest for a Senior Software Engineer who finds joy in building technology and knows the work doesn't end at git commit. For you, the product's potential isn't fulfilled until it's in the hands of users, helping them work better, collaborate effortlessly, all while putting a skip in their step.

As a Senior Software Engineer, you'll work collaboratively with other engineers on all aspects of our product. You'll take ownership of feature delivery in horizontally scalable messaging pipelines while also ensuring the rounded corner of every button in the UI is just right. No doubt you'll come with lots of great ideas of how to evolve the product as you get to explore Fixify's exciting range of features, including large language models (LLMs). We're also big believers in staying close to our customers. So you'll also immerse yourself in our users' environments and refine your work based on their feedback.   • Share the "why" behind every decision so you learn from our collective journey.
  • Connect you with users for direct visibility into how people use the integrations and how your changes impact their day-to-day lives.

What you should bring with you

  • At least 5 years of experience building scalable and observable SaaS solutions with one of the big three cloud platforms (AWS, GCP, Azure).
  • Strong knowledge of Typescript or a passion to quickly learn and master it.
  • A practice of "kind engineering" that produces well documented, modular code that's a delight for the next engineer that works on it.
  • A keen eye for detail – especially when reviewing pull requests.

raw.description:
This is a remote position.

Founding Engineer - Memora

We're hiring a Founding Engineer to step into one of the broadest roles on the team: A hands-on IC role with real product and cultural ownership.

The Why

Memora is growing rapidly. We need an awesome engineer in the team who can lead from all angles of the technical stack:

  • IaC end-to-end (Terraform, AWS, deploys, observability)

  • Data ingestion pipelines (large exports, QGIS, PostGIS, multi tenant setups)

  • Shipping core product features across NestJS, React, and React Native (Expo) mobile apps

  • Being a thoughtful, methodical technical voice in a small team where every engineer has outsized influence

The What (real examples from what we shipped in the last 30 days)

  • Attribute-based filter systems across PostGIS, NestJS APIs, the React, and PMTiles-backed map tiles, so our clients can visualize by contracts, preservation status to even the flower season.

  • Data import pipelines that convert raw PDF cemetery maps into geo-referenced GeoPackages in QGIS, then ingesting into PostGIS. Owning the end-to-end onboarding for new clientele.

  • Terraform: multi-AZ RDS, ECS Fargate autoscaling, CI workflows, AI guardrails, WAF, SNS, and much more.

  • AI: Designing, evaluating and building harnesses where prompts for summaries and activity can be elegantly delivered to communities, tuning guardrails.

  • Production foundations such as RLS (multi-tenancy), idempotency keys + optimistic locking… so on

The Stack

  • Backend: NestJS, TypeScript, MikroORM, PostgreSQL + PostGIS, Inngest for durable workflows

  • Web: React, TanStack Query, MapLibre + PMTiles

  • Mobile: React Native + Expo, Expo Router, native iOS/Android push

  • Infra: AWS (ECS Fargate, RDS, S3, CloudFront, SNS, Bedrock, WAF), Terraform, GH actions (OIDC), Logto

  • Observability: Grafana Cloud, Sentry, CloudWatch

  • Geospatial tooling: QGIS, GeoPackage, PMTiles

  • AI: AWS Bedrock + guardrails, Promptfoo for evals

Who you are

Must have:

  • Typically 8+ years building production software, including at least one role at a growth startup or as a founding/early engineer with sizeable revenue

  • Full-stack: comfortable shipping in TypeScript across backend (Node/NestJS or similar) and React-based frontends

  • Hands-on cloud infrastructure experience: you've owned a Terraform stack on AWS, not just consumed one

  • Strong relational database fundamentals: you've designed schemas, optimized queries, run migrations against large live datasets

  • Comfortable operating in a small team without a clear playbook: you can scope your own work, write your own docs, and triage your own bugs

Strongly preferred:

  • React Native / Expo experience shipping to App Store + Play Store

  • PostGIS or any production geospatial work

  • Experience with row-level security, multi-tenancy patterns, or compliance-sensitive data (we're GDPR + public-sector)

  • Production AI/LLM work prompt design, evals, guardrails

  • B2B/B2G SaaS experience: sales cycles, real customer relationships, public-sector quirks

Bonus:

  • Experience with cemetery, GIS, or public records systems

A Note on AI
Yes, we lean hard on AI coding tools: Claude, Perplexity, Cursor, etc. and we expect you to as well. Engineers who refuse them aren't a fit, but neither are vibe coders. We ship to municipalities managing data for real families, so the bar is robust, well-tested, human-reviewed code, not "the model said it worked."
We treat these tools like a sharp junior pair-programmer: fast, occasionally brilliant, frequently wrong, and never the final authority. That means reading every diff, spotting when its tests are theatre, pushing back on its first "all-inclusive plan" building workflows with planning and review gates baked in, and being able to ship the same feature with the tools turned off. "AI wrote it" is never a defence in a postmortem.
If that distinction is obvious to you, we should talk. If your instinct is to paste this post into Claude and ask for "the final application, make no mistakes", wrong place. We're hiring humans, not the sub-agents we already work with and know well.

How we work

We’re building Memora to be the kind of company we’d want to work for ourselves: high trust, low bureaucracy, and full of people who care deeply about doing great work.

  • We’re remote by design. No, we don’t track hours or expect people to be online all day, but we do expect ownership, communication, and roughly 4 hours of overlap with Copenhagen (CET).

  • We believe great work and great lives aren’t in competition with each other. Remote work means your whole life doesn’t stop when work starts and that’s a good thing by us. Families, school pickups, deep-focus afternoons: we welcome the whole human. We optimize for people doing the best work of their careers while still having a life they’re excited to live.

  • We’re a small team. Currently 5 people, which means you’ll have real autonomy and real influence. Engineers talk to customers, help onboard them, visit cemeteries, and see first-hand how their work impacts real people. There are no layers of management and no “that’s someone else’s problem” mentality.

  • We’re low ego and high standards. We challenge ideas, admit mistakes, ask questions, and care more about getting to the right answer than being right. Psychological safety matters here, and so does excellence.

  • We’re async-first and intentionally lightweight. We write things down, keep meetings purposeful, and avoid process for process’ sake. Our default approach is simple: communicate clearly, make good decisions, and ship.

  • And because we’re building a real team, not just a collection of Slack profiles, we get together for an offsite every quarter somewhere in the world. Last time, we spent the week skiing and working together, because the best ideas don’t always happen in a meeting room.

Compensation & equity

  • Senior IC salary (currency calibrated to location)

  • Meaningful founding-engineer equity grant: we're early enough that this matters and we want you for the full journey

  • Annual leave + Danish-equivalent benefits

  • Quarterly offsites around the world

How to apply

Please send us:

1. A relevant CV

2. A short introduction

3. Pick 2 questions in the questionnaire

We’d rather hear your thoughts than read a polished cover letter. We move fast.

As a Solutions Support Engineer, you will be part of a global team delivering expert-level technical support across the Wiz cloud-native security platform. You'll investigate complex, multi-domain issues spanning cloud infrastructure, workload protection, vulnerability management, and runtime defense - working across AWS, Azure, and GCP environments. This role combines deep technical troubleshooting with a growing emphasis on AI-driven automation to scale support operations and improve resolution quality.

What You'll Do

  • Troubleshoot cloud connector and integration failures across AWS, Azure, GCP, OCI, and SaaS platforms - including IAM/permissions issues, network connectivity, API authentication, and scanning infrastructure
  • Diagnose workload scanning and runtime security issues including outpost deployment, sensor configuration, registry scanning, malware detection, and file integrity monitoring
  • Analyze vulnerability findings - triage false positives, validate detection accuracy, investigate SBOM/SCA results, and assess secret detection and patch management coverage
  • Support shift-left security workflows including CI/CD scanning, IaC security, admission controllers, Kubernetes connectors, and code/version control scanning
  • Design and implement automation that scales the support offering - leveraging AI agents, agentic workflows, and tooling to improve triage accuracy and resolution efficiency
  • Participate in on-call rotation for after-hours, holiday, and weekend support coverage

What You'll Bring

  • 1+ years of hands-on experience deploying, managing, and troubleshooting production Kubernetes clusters and containerized applications
  • Strong understanding of cloud security fundamentals: identity and access management, network segmentation, compliance frameworks, and security posture assessment
  • Experience reading and debugging code in one or more of: Python, Shell, JavaScript/JSON, Java, Go, or Terraform/HCL
  • Proficiency with command-line tools and Linux operating system environments
  • Familiarity with the current AI landscape, including LLM architectures and the integration of AI-driven tooling into technical workflows

Nice to Have

  • Familiarity with Infrastructure-as-Code (Terraform, CloudFormation, Helm) and CI/CD pipelines
  • Experience with GraphQL or REST API debugging and integration
  • Background in compliance frameworks (CIS, NIST, SOC2, PCI-DSS, HIPAA)

raw.excerpt: GitLab is the intelligent orchestration platform for DevSecOps.
raw.description:
GitLab is the intelligent orchestration platform for DevSecOps. GitLab enables organizations to increase developer productivity, improve operational efficiency, reduce security and compliance risk, and accelerate digital transformation. More than 50 million registered users and more than 50% of the Fortune 100* trust GitLab to ship better, more secure software faster.

The same principles built into our products are reflected in how our team works: we embrace AI as a core productivity multiplier, with all team members expected to incorporate AI into their daily workflows to drive efficiency, innovation, and impact. GitLab is where careers accelerate, innovation flourishes, and every voice is valued. Our high-performance culture is driven by our values and continuous knowledge exchange, enabling our team members to reach their full potential while collaborating with industry leaders to solve complex problems. Co-create the future with us as we build technology that transforms how the world develops software.

*Fortune 500® is a registered trademark of Fortune Media IP Limited, used under license. Claim based on GitLab data. Fortune 100 refers to the top 20% ranked companies in the 2025 Fortune 500 list, published in June 2025. Fortune and Fortune Media IP Limited are not affiliated with, and do not endorse products or services of GitLab.

An overview of this role

As a Senior Backend Engineer on GitLab's Nonlinear Productivity team, you'll find and remove friction across the software development lifecycle using reliable AI-powered automation — diagnosing problems like long review cycles, manual release steps, and brittle automation, then building the automation and process changes that resolve them for good.

Some examples of the problems this team takes on:

  • Cutting the time it takes to complete a good code review — one that still keeps a human in the loop — by half, using agentic solutions.
  • Turning a manual, error-prone release step into an agentic workflow that catches its own mistakes before a human ever has to.

What you'll do

  • Identify sources of friction across GitLab's software development lifecycle and scope agentic solutions to address them, turning vague pain points into concrete, buildable proposals.
  • Design and build reliable AI-powered systems that follow step-by-step workflows, use tools and safety checks, and correct errors before taking engineering action — the kind of output you can actually trust with real engineering decisions.
  • Build and maintain evaluation tools that judge agent output on correctness, constraint compliance, and cost, not on whether it merely "seems to work."
  • Work across GitLab's codebase as each problem requires, going wherever the friction actually is rather than staying inside one service or product area.
  • Apply distributed systems judgment to identify generated code that may fail under concurrency, at scale, or across self-managed, dedicated, and multi-tenant deployments, catching failures before they reach customers.
  • Collaborate with the India-based group, sharing roadmaps, findings, and reusable agent tooling
  • Take ownership of a greenfield problem space from day one, helping shape a proven internal fix into a capability GitLab could offer customers externally, with your scope and impact free to grow as the team scales.

What you'll bring

  • Hands-on experience building agentic or large language model-based systems — multi-step orchestration, tool use, guardrails, and recovery patterns — and making them reliable in production, not treated as one-off prompts or demonstrations.
  • A track record of working autonomously in unfamiliar codebases, getting oriented quickly, and driving solutions through completion.
  • Strong distributed systems knowledge, including coordination, consistency, idempotency, rate limiting, failure modes, and degradation under load.
  • Proficiency in Go, Rust, or Python, in that order of team priority, and the ability to read and modify code in the other languages.
  • Helpful experience includes shipping autonomous agents that complete real tasks from start to finish; improving build systems, release processes, review workflows, or other parts of the software development lifecycle; and working with globally distributed teams, large language model workload costs, or production constraints across on-premises, air-gapped, single-tenant, and software-as-a-service deployments.

About the team

Nonlinear Productivity — shortened internally to "NLP," with no relation to natural language processing — is one of GitLab's newest teams: a strategic incubation group that reports into AI Platform leadership under the direct sponsorship of the CTO. It's split into a US group (this role) and an India-based group working the same charter; the two sync on roadmap and tooling a few times a week but otherwise run day to day on their own. It operates like a startup — no dedicated product manager, no pre-set backlog — and solutions that prove out internally are the team's path to a monetized, customer-facing GitLab offering.

It's a good fit for engineers who'd rather go find the next problem than be handed one, and who want a hand in defining a brand-new part of GitLab from its first commit.

Remote-Global

  • Flexible Paid Time Off
  • Team Member Resource Groups
  • Equity Compensation & Employee Stock Purchase Plan
  • Growth and Development Fund

  • Tenure: A documented history of long-term commitment in previous professional roles.

raw.description:
Coupa makes margins multiply through its community-generated AI and industry-leading total spend management platform for businesses large and small. Coupa AI is informed by trillions of dollars of direct and indirect spend data across a global network of 10M+ buyers and suppliers. We empower you with the ability to predict, prescribe, and automate smarter, more profitable business decisions to improve operating margins.

Why join Coupa?

🔹 Pioneering Technology: At Coupa, we're at the forefront of innovation, leveraging the latest technology to empower our customers with greater efficiency and visibility in their spend.
🔹 Collaborative Culture: We value collaboration and teamwork, and our culture is driven by transparency, openness, and a shared commitment to excellence.
🔹 Global Impact: Join a company where your work has a global, measurable impact on our clients, the business, and each other.
Learn more on Life at Coupa blog and hear from our employees about their experiences working at Coupa.

What You'll Do:

  • Build and extend the eval pipeline: how we measure task completion, catch regressions, and turn production failures into fixed behaviors.
  • Work on context management: what the agent sees, when, and how we keep long-horizon tasks coherent without burning tokens.
  • Design sub-agent patterns: when to fan out, how to compose specialized agents cleanly, and how to keep the parent agent in control of the outcome.
  • Own document parsing: turning supplier-uploaded invoices, catalogs, and contracts into structured context the agent can reason over.
  • Wrap Coupa supplier APIs as agent-callable CLI tools, with clean error surfaces and sensible defaults for an agent caller.
  • Ship supplier-facing skills on top of the harness: the procedural instructions and tool compositions that let the agent handle specific tasks end-to-end.
  • Debug messy production behavior: why did the agent take that path, where did it get confused, and what tool, context, or harness change fixes it?
  • Partner with the senior engineer on harness architecture calls as you find gaps while working across the stack.

What You Will Bring to Coupa:

  • Have 3–5 years shipping production software and are strong in Python (TypeScript a plus).
  • Have shipped at least one LLM-powered feature or product, even if small, and can talk about what went wrong and what you'd do differently.
  • Are a daily, heavy user of agentic coding tools — Claude Code, Cursor, Codex, or equivalents.
  • Have side projects. Real ones. Things you've built because you couldn't stop thinking about them. Ideally things the new generation of AI tools made possible for you to finish.
  • Write and speak English fluently. Skill authoring is prose-heavy and the team operates in English.
  • Debug by reading, not by guessing. You reach for logs, traces, and evals before theorizing.

  • Volunteer Time Off (VTO): Giving back is in our DNA. We offer 40 hours of paid VTO annually to support the community initiatives and volunteer programs you are passionate about .
  • Employee Assistance Program (EAP): Access free, confidential, 24/7/365 counseling and resources for emotional support, work-life solutions, financial advice, legal guidance, and support for new parents .
  • Business Travel Protection: Travel with peace of mind. Zurich Travel Assist provides medical, safety, pre-trip planning, and emergency support during any business travel .
  • Referral Bonus Program: Share the Coupa experience! Receive generous monetary referral bonuses when you successfully refer talented friends or acquaintances who are hired into open roles .
Please note: In addition to these global well-being perks, Coupa offers highly competitive, location-specific benefits packages (which include comprehensive medical/dental insurance, retirement/pension plans, and life or accident protection) tailored to your primary work location. raw.description:
dein arbeitsumfeld

Als jüngstes Mitglied der Consileon Unternehmensgruppe steht die Opereon Consulting GmbH vor einer spannenden Zeit. Sei nicht nur ein Zuschauer – bei uns kannst du aktiv am rasanten Wachstum eines ambitionierten Unternehmens teilhaben und deinen Fußabdruck in der Unternehmensgeschichte hinterlassen. Und wer sagt, dass dies nicht auch dein Sprungbrett für eine Karriere auf der Überholspur ist?
Wir bei Opereon bieten branchenübergreifende Lösungen für Digitalisierungsprojekte – vom Mittelstand bis zu DAX-Konzernen. In der facettenreichen Welt der IT-Projekte sind wir die Spezialisten, die Ideen in die Tat umsetzen.

deine rolle bei uns

  • Software-Entwicklung: Arbeite in Projekten für renommierte Kunden als Entwickler.
  • Frontend, Backend oder Fullstack: Du kannst alle Rollen einnehmen, je nach Projekt- und Kundenbedarf.
  • Du wirst nicht nur stumpf Code runterschreiben, sondern dir auch über Zusammenhänge, Auswirkungen und die Architektur Gedanken machen.
  • KI wird dein ständiger Wegbegleiter sein: Als dein persönlicher Code-Assistent, aber auch in deinen Implementierungsprojekten.
  • Du wirst Teil der agilen Projektteams unserer Kunden sein und als Entwickler eine wesentliche Rolle einnehmen.
  • Du wirst gemeinsam mit deinen Kollegen unsere interne Toolsuite weiterentwickeln – und dabei massiv voneinander lernen.
  • Ausblick: Als Entwickler hast du nahezu unbegrenzte Möglichkeiten: Lead-Dev, Tech-Spezialist, Architekt, Security-Spezialist, Cloud-Experte, Projektleiter, Tester – wohin auch immer deine ganz persönliche Reise gehen soll.

was wir von dir erwarten

  • Du hast mindestens fünf Jahre Praxiserfahrung als Software-Entwickler.
  • Du hast einen starken Backend-Techstack (Java/Kotlin + Spring Framework oder Python + Django Framework oder GO), kannst SQL / NoSQL und beherrschst React, JS, TS (zudem wünschenswert: Angular, benutzung von GraphQL, arbeiten mit OpenAPI standards).
  • Du bist geübt in professioneller Entwicklung, kennst gängige Tools und Frameworks und verstehst Cloud (AWS, Azure oder Google), CI/CD-Pipelines, DevOps (Github Actions/TravisCI/AWS Pipelines/o.Ä.) und Kubernetes.
  • Du lebst die Prinzipien (sinnvoll angewendeter!) agiler Softwareentwicklung, weist um den Nutzen von Ticketsystemen und kannst im Team arbeiten.
  • Du bist Techie – kannst aber auch mit Kunden oder Vertretern der Fachabteilungen auf Augenhöhe diskutieren.

sechs gute gründe für uns

  1. Flexibilität: Wähle wann und wo du arbeitest.
  2. Zusammenarbeit auf Augenhöhe: Bei uns zählt jeder Beitrag, unabhängig von der Hierarchie. Business und IT gehen Hand in Hand, wir unterscheiden im Rollenmodell nicht zwischen Fachberatern und Techies.
  3. Arbeit im Team: Du arbeitest nicht alleine, sondern bist Teil eines Teams – bei unseren Kunden, aber auch intern mit deinen Kollegen.
  4. Bei uns darfst du Nerd sein. Wir freuen uns, mehr über deine Schrullen und deine verrückten Hobbies zu erfahren – denn ehrlich, wir sind doch selbst nicht anders.
  5. Individuelle Weiterentwicklung: Du entscheidest, wohin es gehen soll und welche Schulungen und Weiterbildungen für dich am besten passen – wir beraten und begleiten dich auf deiner Reise.
  6. Entfaltungsmöglichkeiten: Wähle deinen eigenen Weg und beschreite ihn. Überzeuge durch deine Leistung und deine Skills als Entwickler. Wir freuen uns auf dich!

The Systems and Project Manager is a senior individual contributor in CashForCars, reporting to Direct Buy Portal Manager. The position bridges business operations, technology, analytics, marketing, and project execution. The role requires strong systems knowledge, excellent communication, disciplined follow-through, and the ability to translate business needs into clear technical and operational action.

Tasks
• Serve as the business-side hub for high level active technology issues impacting CashForCars operations reported by fellow management or supervisor level employees.
• Track open tickets, upcoming enhancements, system issues, and project priorities through Jira and Confluence.

• Identify process gaps, system limitations, automation opportunities, and workflow improvements and assist in execution of instituting necessary changes.
• Provide clear, proactive updates to stakeholders on risks, status, dependencies, and next steps.
• Oversee an office coordinator/administrative assistant employee in handling of minor day to day tech issues when needed for escalation.

Qualifications and requirements
• Strong experience working across business operations, systems, stakeholders, and project teams.
• Ability to translate complex operational needs into clear business requirements, user stories, documentation, and follow-up actions.
• Experience with Salesforce, Jira, and related business systems; familiarity with Calabrio preferred.
• Strong analytical, written communication, verbal communication, organization, and independent problem-solving skills.

Competencies
• Communication - provides clear, timely, and proactive updates across business and technical teams.
• Systems thinking - understands how technology, process, campaigns, and business outcomes connect.
• Ownership - follows issues through to resolution and maintains visibility on critical workstreams.
• Business acumen - understands CashForCars priorities and applies sound judgment to technical and operational decisions.
• Continuous improvement - identifies better ways to use tools, automation, AI, and process design.

We're transforming the grocery industry

At Instacart, we invite the world to share love through food because we believe everyone should have access to the food they love and more time to enjoy it together. Where others see a simple need for grocery delivery, we see exciting complexity and endless opportunity to serve the varied needs of our community. We work to deliver an essential service that customers rely on to get their groceries and household goods, while also offering safe and flexible earnings opportunities to Instacart Personal Shoppers.

Instacart has become a lifeline for millions of people, and we’re building the team to help push our shopping cart forward. If you’re ready to do the best work of your life, come join our table.

Instacart is a Flex First team

There’s no one-size fits all approach to how we do our best work. Our employees have the flexibility to choose where they do their best work—whether it’s from home, an office, or your favorite coffee shop—while staying connected and building community through regular in-person events. Learn more about our flexible approach to where we work.

Overview

Instacart’s Strategic Finance team partners closely with leaders across the business to drive clarity, rigor, and results. Within this group, the Retailer Pod supports our retailer partnerships by shaping deal strategy, building robust financial models, and guiding decisions that help Instacart and our partners grow together.

We are seeking a Senior Financial Analyst to accelerate retailer deal flow and portfolio performance. You will join a high-impact, collaborative pod within Strategic Finance, working daily with Retail Partnerships, Deal Desk, Legal, Revenue Operations, Data Science, and Accounting. In this role, you’ll own end-to-end financial analysis for complex commercial deals, build scalable forecasting frameworks, and present actionable insights that influence decisions at the highest levels.

This is an opportunity to roll up your sleeves in a fast-paced, evolving environment, bring structure to ambiguity, and make a visible impact on Instacart’s growth. You’ll help us go far together by pairing analytical depth with crisp storytelling that moves the business forward.

About the Job

  • Own end-to-end financial modeling for retailer partnerships, including pricing strategies, incentive structures, unit economics, and ROI analyses with scenario and sensitivity testing.
  • Partner with Retail Partnerships and Deal Desk to translate strategy into clear financial outcomes; support negotiations with data-driven recommendations and crisp trade-off frameworks.
  • Build and maintain driver-based forecasts for a portfolio of retailer deals; establish KPIs, track performance vs. plan, and surface insights that improve margin and payback.
  • Design and standardize scalable templates, playbooks, and dashboards that streamline diligence, approval, and post-close performance management.
  • Create executive-ready materials—models, memos, and presentations—that distill complex analyses into clear narratives and decisions.
  • Collaborate cross-functionally with Data Science, Accounting, Revenue Operations, and Legal to ensure operational feasibility, policy alignment, and accurate financial treatment.

About You

Minimum Qualifications

  • 4+ years of experience in Strategic Finance, FP&A, Investment Banking, Private Equity, or Management Consulting supporting commercial deals or growth initiatives in technology, e-commerce, marketplace, logistics, or retail.
  • Bachelor’s degree in Finance, Economics, Accounting, Business, a related quantitative field, or equivalent practical experience.
  • Advanced financial modeling skills in Excel/Google Sheets, including driver-based models, cohort and retention analysis, and scenario/sensitivity analysis.
  • Proficiency in SQL for self-serve analysis and experience with a BI tool (e.g., Looker or Tableau).
  • Demonstrated experience evaluating or structuring commercial partnerships or contracts (pricing, unit economics, and ROI modeling) and presenting recommendations to senior stakeholders.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience with marketplace or retailer/CPG partnerships and multi-sided platform economics.
  • Hands-on collaboration with Sales/Partnerships and Legal on deal terms (e.g., volume commitments, incentives, performance SLAs).
  • Familiarity with revenue recognition concepts (e.g., ASC 606) and how contract structures impact financial treatment.
  • Experience building dashboards in Looker/Tableau and automating workflows with SQL or Python.
  • MBA, CFA, or CPA.

raw.description:
Oh, hello there, wearer of many hats.

Funday is a full service agency made up of people who are friendly and hardworking in equal measure. Inspired by an unrelenting belief that having fun is integral to creativity, we like to say we’re all about fun and brains. You know, that sweet spot between where pretty and performance meet and where insight and imagination produce the entirely unexpected? That’s where we thrive.

Senior Engagement Manager

We are looking for an experienced account manager who is also skilled in project management; this role is a hybrid, and we need someone who has a diverse skill set that bridges the project and account worlds. One minute you’ll discuss the details of a project’s deliverables with the creative team and the next, you’ll be talking budgets with your client. These roles aren’t always combined, but when they are, it’s pretty fun.

You will be expected to run your own account(s), and work with team members at all levels. Our clients and our team members are scattered around the globe. We’re a smaller group, so everyone gets their hands dirty. You’ll always be working with a team who has a passion for great work, including creatives, strategists and technologists who will help you push the work forward.

Location: You’ll work remotely from Toronto, Ontario.

What you’ll do

Account Management Responsibilities - A strong account manager takes the time to understand the client and their business and can even anticipate their needs. They are the bridge between the client and our internal team; they ensure clear communication between both sides and have the tough conversations when necessary.

  • Act as the primary contact for projects between the client, team, and vendors
  • Identify opportunities to deliver on client’s needs or to solve problems
  • Build positive working relationships with key client teams
  • Understand and anticipate clients’ short and long-term goals, as well as their competition
  • Manage issues in a professional and timely manner, finding solutions and consensus among all parties

Project Management Responsibilities - A strong project manager takes the time to understand what it is the client needs so they can take that information back to the team and communicate it in a way that they can easily get to creating the magic. They are very organized and scheduled but can stop everything and switch directions at the drop of a hat.

  • Ensure everything is in place to run and execute a project on time and within budget
  • Translate the clients’ needs into a language the team understands to get the work done
  • Conduct thorough scoping, planning, costing, and timing of projects
  • Oversee the entire delivery and execution process, ensuring and facilitating effective team communication and collaboration
  • Own, facilitate, document, and disseminate outcomes for meetings
  • Manage development priorities and timelines
  • Manage creative activities and client reviews
  • Communicate project status/risks to stakeholders
  • Identify, document, and communicate issues and changes that may affect the project

What you’ll need to succeed

  • Minimum 4-5 years recent experience in a marketing/advertising agency environment required, 5 - 7 years preferred
  • 6 - 8 years in an account management or project management role with at least 3 years experience in a hybrid accounts and project management role
  • Proven ability to move between the accounts and project worlds
  • Proven ability to grow client accounts
  • Experience working in an inter-agency setting is an asset
  • Adept at managing multiple clients and projects with heavily matrixed teams
  • Experience managing projects through the entire lifecycle, from planning to execution
  • Attention to detail and strong organizational and people management skills
  • Excellent communication, presentation, and facilitation skills
  • Flexibility when faced with changing priorities or circumstances
  • Experience with project management and issue tracking tools
  • Experience with budgeting and resource management
  • Experience managing project teams including deliverables, timelines, and internal prioritization
  • Experience managing all aspects of conversations with clients, including project intake, briefing, longer term planning, and challenging conversations
  • Experience mentoring or managing junior team members

You’ll want to read this part

  • Where you live & can work matters: If you live in Canada, are able to work here, and you are in Toronto, Ontario - please apply! Otherwise, we’re sorry, we’re not currently hiring for this role outside of that area.
  • This posting is for an existing vacancy we are looking to fill immediately and not a prospective future role (i.e. we’re saying this isn’t a ghost job).

About the Role

At Pavago, one of our clients is hiring a Real Estate Deal Analyst & Coordinator to manage and optimize a high-volume real estate deal pipeline.

This role is ideal for someone with experience in real estate operations, acquisitions, transaction coordination, or deal analysis who enjoys keeping transactions organized from lead through closing. You’ll work closely with buyers, sellers, agents, title companies, and internal teams to evaluate opportunities, coordinate communication, and keep deals moving efficiently.

Responsibilities

Deal Analysis

  • Review property information, deal structures, and investment opportunities.
  • Analyze financial and operational data to support acquisition decisions.
  • Prepare deal summaries and recommendations for leadership.

Pipeline Management

  • Track active deals from lead through closing.
  • Monitor deadlines, milestones, and follow-ups.
  • Identify risks or bottlenecks that could delay transactions.

Communication & Coordination

  • Coordinate communication between buyers, sellers, agents, title companies, and internal stakeholders.
  • Schedule meetings, calls, and follow-ups.
  • Ensure all parties remain aligned throughout the transaction process.

CRM & Documentation

  • Maintain accurate CRM records, notes, and deal statuses.
  • Prepare reports and supporting documentation.
  • Keep deal files organized and up to date.

Process Improvement

  • Identify workflow inefficiencies.
  • Recommend improvements that increase transaction speed and operational efficiency.

Required Experience & Skills

  • Experience in real estate operations, acquisitions, transaction coordination, deal management, or a similar role.
  • Strong analytical skills with the ability to evaluate property and transaction data.
  • Excellent organizational and project management skills.
  • Strong written and verbal English communication skills.
  • Experience with CRM systems and Google Workspace.
  • Ability to manage multiple active deals simultaneously.
  • Self-motivated with the ability to work independently in a remote environment.
  • Reliable internet connection and availability for 30+ hours per week.

Nice to Have

  • Experience in real estate investing, wholesaling, acquisitions, or dispositions.
  • Familiarity with U.S. real estate transactions and terminology.
  • Experience with Podio, Follow Up Boss, REI BlackBook, or similar platforms.
  • Experience supporting high-volume real estate investment teams.

What Success Looks Like

  • Deals move through the pipeline efficiently and on schedule.
  • CRM records remain accurate and up to date.
  • Clear, proactive communication with all stakeholders.
  • Leadership has visibility into deal status and next steps.
  • Process improvements increase transaction volume and efficiency.

Interview Process

  • Initial Recruiter Screening
  • Intro Video (Spark Hire)
  • Client Interview
  • Offer & Onboarding

What Happens After You Apply

Right after you apply, you’ll receive an email invitation from Spark Hire to record your Intro Video. It’s a short, self-recorded video that completes your application and allows hiring managers to get to know you before the interview process begins.

Rather than repeating your background during multiple screening calls, you’ll tell your story once, allowing future interviews to focus on meaningful conversations.

Don’t overthink it—you can record as many takes as you’d like before submitting. Your invitation will come from Spark Hire, so please check both your inbox and spam folder.

About Sellers Dorsey

Sellers Dorsey is a healthcare impact strategy firm focused on improving care access, quality, and outcomes for our nation’s most vulnerable populations. We work with providers, managed care organizations, state entities, and others, to design, implement, fund, and optimize sustainable programs that deliver maximum impact to underserved communities. Built on decades of experience in Medicaid, our team includes former state Medicaid directors, healthcare policy experts, health plan execs, and hospital leaders who know how to navigate the complexities of the system and find creative, impactful solutions that drive the greatest impact for the individuals and communities that need it most.

About the Role

Sellers Dorsey is seeking two Senior Consultants, Quality Management & Client Success to support clients across providers, hospitals/health systems, state Medicaid agencies, and managed care organizations by blending expertise in CMS‑aligned quality programs with hands‑on delivery of quality improvement, population health, care management support, and claims/encounter data quality. As a Senior Consultant, Quality Management & Client Success, you will contribute technical expertise in quality measurement, gap closure strategies, population health analytics, healthcare process improvement, and claims/encounter data integrity. You will play a critical role in day-to-day project execution, analysis, and client support; develop tools, reports, and recommendations; and collaborate cross-functionally with Regions, National Consulting, and Analytics teams. You will also support scopes of work stemming from adoption of Constyn, Sellers Dorsey's population health SaaS platform, and contributes to light sales/RFP development activities.

Key Responsibilities

1- Project Execution for Client Quality Initiatives:

  • Support day-to-day work on traditional CMS quality/value-based care projects such as Directed Payment Programs, 105 Quality initiatives, workforce initiatives and others, including development of quality components and documentation aligned to CMS requirements and state expectations.

  • Participate in internal and external meetings; track tasks, risks, and timelines; and prepare client-ready materials that connect financing models with quality strategies and outcomes.

  • Prepare and deliver internal and client-facing presentations and materials that explain quality processes, policy context, program impact and project progress in accessible terms.

2- Quality Measurement, Gap Closure & Data Interpretation:

  • Aggregate and analyze quality and population health data (including claims/encounters) to assess performance, identify gaps, and inform recommendations.

  • Contribute to measure selection, target setting, measure definition documents, reporting templates, dashboards, and evaluation summaries that demonstrate program impact.

3- Population Health, Risk & Care Management Support:

  • Assist in designing and operationalizing gap-closure workflows, risk stratification, and care management processes that complement financing and quality program goals.

  • Translate analytic 7.findings into practical action steps for clinical and operational teams.

4- Policy & Guidance Monitoring with Application to Client Work:

  • Monitor state and federal policy developments and CMS quality guidance, synthesizing implications for CMS financed programs (DPPs, 105s) and quality/population health scopes; brief project teams and clients.

5- Cross-Functional Collaboration (Regions, National Consulting, Analytics):

  • Partner with internal teams in a matrixed environment to scope analytics, define data requirements, interpret outputs, and produce integrated deliverables.

  • Help convert analytic insights into operational recommendations and quality interventions.

6- Support Client Success with Constyn-Enabled Scopes (SaaS):

  • Support Constyn onboarding and workflows (e.g., dashboard interpretation, cohort/risk views, performance reporting); provide voice-of-client feedback to enhance product utility.

7- Other Duties as Assigned:

  • Support firmwide strategic initiatives, tool development, and cross-department projects; perform additional responsibilities consistent with the role’s scope and expertise.

  • Contribute to internal training and team knowledge assets.

Key Qualifications

  • Bachelor’s degree required (Public Policy, Public Administration, Public Health, Health Administration or related. Advanced degree preferred or additional relevant experience in lieu of an advanced degree. CPHQ Preferred.

  • 5–10 years in healthcare quality improvement, quality measurement, and/or healthcare consulting/operations.

  • Experience with value-based care models, pay for performance programs and experience supporting quality improvement/population health initiatives (gap closure, risk/care management, claims/encounter data).

  • Knowledge of quality measures across payers (e.g., NCQA HEDIS, CMS Core Sets) and comfort interpreting analytic outputs to inform recommendations.

  • Excellent written and verbal communication with the ability to translate complex policy and analytics into practical guidance.

  • Organization and multitasking across several projects; initiative with appropriate escalation; collaborates effectively in a matrixed environment; serves as a role model for junior colleagues

Critical Professional related Technical Skills

  • Proficiency in Microsoft Word, Excel, PowerPoint.

  • Proficiency with Microsoft collaboration tools: SharePoint, Teams.

  • Experience with business intelligence software (Tableau/Power BI), project management software (Smartsheet) or statistical software (R, SAS, SPSS) a plus.

Compensation & Benefits

The anticipated salary range for candidates is $96,000/year in our lowest geographic market range to up to $125,000/year. The final pay offered to a successful candidate will be dependent on several factors that may include but are not limited to the type and years of experience within the job, the type of years and experience within the industry, the candidate’s education, and the candidate’s market location. Typically, candidates are not hired near the top of the range and compensation decisions are made based upon Sellers Dorsey’s Total Compensation Policies & Guidelines. The successful candidate will also be eligible to participate in our annual Corporate Incentive Plan (CIP) that can range to up to 9% of annual salary.

Provided they meet all eligibility requirements under the applicable plan documents, the successful candidate (and their eligible dependents) will be eligible to enroll in group healthcare plans that offer medical, dental, and vision and for insurance plans offering short term disability, long term disability, and basic life. Employees are also able to enroll in Sellers Dorsey’s 401k plan provided they meet plan requirements. Sellers Dorsey offers a Flexible Time Off that allows employees to use what they need. Additionally, we offer 10 paid holidays throughout the calendar year, paid time off for qualifying medical leave, and up to 12 weeks of combined paid parental and bonding leave. The foregoing benefits and paid time off, including an employee’s eligibility therefore, will be controlled by applicable plan documents and Sellers Dorsey policy.

This is intended to provide a general description of benefits and other compensation and is not a substitute for applicable plan documents or company policies.

Sellers Dorsey is an Equal Employment/Affirmative Action employer. We do not discriminate in hiring on the basis of sex, gender identity, sexual orientation, race, color, religious creed, national origin, physical or mental disability, protected Veteran status, or any other characteristic protected by federal, state, or local law.

Requests for accommodation will be considered on a case-by-case basis. Please note that only inquiries concerning a request for reasonable accommodation will be responded to from this e-mail address.

raw.excerpt: Mindrift is looking for skilled Mobile App Developers (React Native, Flutter, Swift, or Kotlin) to join the Tendem project () and build native and cross-platform mobile applications for real-world use cases.
raw.description:
Mindrift is looking for skilled Mobile App Developers (React Native, Flutter, Swift, or Kotlin) to join the Tendem project () and build native and cross-platform mobile applications for real-world use cases. In this role, you'll apply your mobile engineering expertise to build stable, performant, and user-friendly applications for iOS and Android. This part-time remote opportunity is ideal for professionals with hands-on experience shipping iOS and/or Android apps, working with platform APIs, and handling the full mobile development lifecycle.

What We Do

The Mindrift platform connects specialists with innovative technology projects. Our mission is to help develop high-quality AI technologies by combining real-world expertise from professionals across the globe with advanced AI development efforts.

About the Role

This is a freelance role for a Tendem project. As a Mobile App Developer, you'll design, build, and refine mobile applications across categories such as utilities, fitness/wellness, games, productivity, delivery, and content apps — for iOS, Android, or both, using native or cross-platform frameworks.

Key Responsibilities

  • Build mobile applications using React Native, Flutter, Swift (iOS), or Kotlin (Android).
  • Implement responsive mobile UIs that follow platform conventions (iOS HIG, Material Design).
  • Integrate native device features (camera, push notifications, location, storage, biometrics).
  • Connect apps to backend APIs, handle offline state, caching, and synchronization.
  • Implement monetization features where required (in-app purchases, ads, subscriptions).
  • Review, debug, optimize, and refactor mobile application code to improve correctness, performance, battery efficiency, and maintainability.
  • Debug platform-specific issues and prepare builds for distribution (TestFlight, Play Console).

Educational qualifications

  • At least 3 years of relevant experience in mobile app development (required).
  • Bachelor's or Master's Degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Information Technology, or related technical fields is a plus.

Academic and/or Professional Experience

Candidates should have a strong foundation in mobile application development, platform-specific UI/UX patterns, and building stable, high-quality mobile experiences for iOS and Android. We are looking for specialists who can confidently work with native or cross-platform frameworks, integrate device APIs and backend services, and build production-ready mobile applications. Strong attention to detail, performance awareness, and the ability to work independently are essential.

Technical Skills (Essential)

  • Hands-on experience with at least one of: React Native, Flutter, Swift/SwiftUI (iOS), or Kotlin/Jetpack Compose (Android).
  • Solid understanding of mobile UI patterns, navigation, state management, and platform guidelines.
  • Experience integrating REST APIs, handling async data, and managing local storage.
  • Familiarity with native device APIs (notifications, camera, location, storage, biometrics).
  • Experience with mobile build tools, code signing, and submission to App Store / Google Play.
  • Experience implementing in-app purchases, ads, or subscriptions is a plus.
  • Familiarity with backend services such as Firebase, Supabase, or similar is a plus.

Additional requirements

  • Strong attention to detail and commitment to performance, stability, and platform polish.
  • Self-directed work ethic with the ability to ship complete mobile features independently.
  • Portfolio of shipped mobile apps (required, with App Store / Google Play links preferred).
  • English proficiency: Upper-intermediate (B2) or above (required)

Project time expectations

For this project, tasks are estimated to require around 10–20 hours per week during active phases, based on project requirements. This is an estimate, not a guaranteed workload, and applies only while the project is active.

Compensation

On this project, contributors can earn up to $60 per hour equivalent, depending on their level and pace of contribution.

Compensation varies across projects depending on scope, complexity, and required expertise. Please note that other projects on the platform may offer different earning levels based on their requirements.

Why this freelance opportunity might be a great fit for you?

  • Work fully remote on your own schedule with just a laptop and stable internet connection.
  • Apply your expertise to real-world technology projects while gaining experience building high-quality solutions for a global platform.
  • Participate in performance-based bonus programs that reward high-quality work and consistent delivery.
