raw.description:
Job Description

Où vous travaillerez : n'importe où au Québec

Le développement logiciel chez GoTo

Nous sommes des pionniers de la technologie du travail à distance, qui créons des solutions puissantes et flexibles qui permettent à chacun de vivre sa vie au mieux, au travail et en dehors. Avec nous, vous aurez l’occasion d’ouvrir de nouvelles portes et de contribuer à redéfinir la façon dont l’humanité travaille. Pour nous, l’IA n’est pas qu’un mot à la mode, c’est un outil que nous utilisons pour apporter une valeur réelle et concrète à nos clients et à nos équipes. Nous nous concentrons sur la résolution de problèmes significatifs, et non sur l’ajout de fonctionnalités d’IA tape-à-l’œil. Ici, la croissance prend de nombreuses formes : vous pouvez diversifier vos compétences, relever de nouveaux défis, mener des initiatives et explorer des idées créatives. Rejoignez une équipe produit GoTo et jouez un rôle clé dans la transformation du lieu de travail pour des millions d’utilisateurs dans le monde entier. Votre travail fera vraiment une différence.

Votre quotidien

En tant que spécialiste sénior en gestion de produits pour la plateforme d’identité, votre travail inclura les tâches suivantes :

Responsabilité de la plateforme : Vous serez responsable de la feuille de route et de la vision pour la plateforme d’identité de GoTo, les droits d’accès et l’approvisionnement des UGS (la couche qui sous-tend presque toutes les expériences de facturation et de produit) afin d’assurer un accès sécurisé, fiable et évolutif à grande échelle. Vous améliorerez les expériences de connexion, réduirez les obstacles liés à la vérification de l’identité pour l’équipe de soutien et gérerez la feuille de route pour OAuth et l’AMF.

Gestion des utilisateurs et des accès : Vous serez responsable de l’approvisionnement des utilisateurs, des paramètres des comptes et du contrôle de l’accès, tant pour les clients finaux que pour les équipes internes. Vous résoudrez la façon dont différents types d’utilisateurs (employés, partenaires, agents) sont approvisionnés et configurés et dont leur accès est révoqué.

Modèles commerciaux des partenaires : Vous traduirez les modèles commerciaux des partenaires en exigences techniques relatives aux droits d’accès et à la structure des comptes, en collaborant avec le développement logiciel, les opérations des revenus (RevOps) et les opérations partenaires pour les mettre en œuvre.

Authentification agentique : Vous serez responsable de la façon dont les agents d’IA s’authentifient, sont habilités et sont encadrés lorsqu’ils agissent au nom d’un utilisateur, en vous assurant que GoTo suive l’évolution des normes dans ce domaine.

Fiabilité et continuité de la plateforme : Vous serez responsable de la résolution des causes fondamentales (et non seulement des solutions temporaires) lorsque la logique d’identité ou de droits d’accès échoue, et vous mettrez en place la documentation ainsi que les pratiques de transfert des connaissances nécessaires pour maintenir ce système essentiel à l’entreprise résilient et exempt de points de défaillance uniques.

Ce que nous recherchons

En tant que spécialiste sénior en gestion de produits pour la plateforme d’identité, vous devriez avoir un profil similaire au suivant :

  • Au minimum 3 ans d’expérience en gestion de produits avec responsabilité directe d’une plateforme liée à l’identité, à l’authentification/l’autorisation, aux droits d’accès ou à la gestion des accès.
  • Bonne connaissance des principes fondamentaux de l’authentification (AMF, OAuth/OIDC, SSO) et expérience pratique de prise de décision entre créer ou acheter une solution d’identité ou d’authentification.
  • Expérience dans le lancement de fonctionnalités pour des logiciels-services de facturation ou de commerce, y compris la gestion de la correspondance entre les unités de gestion des stocks (UGS) et les droits d’accès ainsi que la prise en charge de modèles de facturation par abonnement ou par l’intermédiaire de partenaires.
  • Capacité démontrée à gérer de quatre à six flux de travail simultanés (ou plus) sans en négliger aucun.
  • Excellente gestion des parties prenantes interfonctionnelles, dont le développement logiciel, les opérations des revenus (RevOps), le service juridique et la sécurité, ainsi que les partenaires externes.

Ce que nous offrons

Chez GoTo, nous croyons qu’il est important de soutenir nos employés avec une gamme complète d’avantages conçus pour s’adapter à votre vie, au travail comme ailleurs. Voici seulement quelques-uns des avantages auxquels vous pouvez vous attendre en rejoignant notre équipe :

  • Prestations de santé complètes, assurance vie et invalidité, programmes d’aide à la fertilité et à la constitution d’une famille;
  • Congés et vacances payés généreux, congés pour bénévolat, journées de bien-être personnel trimestrielles et journées sans réunions;
  • Programmes de remboursement des frais de scolarité et de lecture pour appuyer votre formation continue et votre développement professionnel;
  • Programme de bien-être Thrive Global, programme confidentiel d’aide aux employés (PAE), encadrement individuel en matière de bien-être;
  • Programmes pour les employés – dont des groupes de ressources pour les employés (GRE), le programme « GoTo s’implique » et notre programme de jumelage des dons de bienfaisance – permettant d’amplifier votre réseau social et les bienfaits de vos actions.
  • Un régime enregistré d’épargne-retraite (REER) pour vous aider à planifier votre avenir.
  • Des programmes de remboursement des frais de gym pour favoriser votre bien-être physique.
  • L’accès à des services de télémédecine pour un accès pratique aux soins de santé.
  • Un programme de primes au rendement GoTo pour célébrer votre implication et vos contributions.
  • Une allocation mensuelle de travail à distance pour couvrir les frais de votre bureau à domicile.

*** Langue de travail pour les postes situés au Québec

La connaissance du français est requise pour les postes situés en permanence au Québec afin que le titulaire puisse communiquer au besoin avec ses collègues, les partenaires et les fournisseurs au Québec. Une formation en français est offerte à tout titulaire d’un poste permanent au Québec qui ne possède pas une bonne connaissance du français.

*** Autres exigences linguistiques

La maîtrise de l’anglais est requise pour ce poste afin de communiquer avec les collègues, les clients et les partenaires (ou les fournisseurs) qui sont majoritairement situés à l’extérieur du Québec. Pour les postes en recherche et développement, il est également nécessaire de comprendre la documentation technique et scientifique de notre industrie disponible majoritairement en anglais.

Chez GoTo, vous trouverez la flexibilité, les ressources et le soutien dont vous avez besoin pour vous épanouir au travail, à la maison et partout ailleurs. Vous travaillerez à la réalisation d’un objectif commun avec une équipe ouverte d’esprit et unie dont l’impact est plus grand que la somme de ses parties. Nous nous engageons à créer un espace inclusif pour tous, parce que nous savons que ces perspectives uniques font de nous une entreprise et une communauté plus forte. Joignez-vous à nous pour faire partie d’une entreprise qui investit dans votre avenir. Ensemble, nous serons authentiques, nous verrons grand, nous avancerons rapidement, nous grandirons continuellement et nous maintiendrons notre priorité client.En savoir plus.

raw.description:
As a Bid and Proposal Manager, you will play a pivotal role in securing funding that enables Catch22 to deliver life-changing services across the UK. Working within a high-performing and collaborative Business Development team, you will lead the development of major public sector and grant funding opportunities, shaping innovative solutions that respond to complex social challenges and drive sustainable organisational growth.

This is an exciting opportunity to work at the heart of strategic growth, influencing service design, developing partnerships, and leading bids that have a direct impact on the communities we serve. You'll take ownership of high-profile opportunities while collaborating with colleagues across the organisation to maximise our success.

Your responsibilities will include:

  • Leading complex public sector bids and grant funding proposals from assessment through to submission, securing significant income and strategic growth opportunities for Catch22.
  • Managing end-to-end bid and proposal processes, delivering high-quality, compliant submissions within tight timescales and governance requirements.
  • Developing compelling, high-scoring bid content and innovative, outcomes-focused solutions that respond effectively to commissioner and funder requirements.
  • Bringing together operational leaders, external partners and subject matter experts to create credible, deliverable and commercially competitive service models.
  • Conducting competitor analysis and bid strategy development to inform bid decisions and maximise win rates.
  • Building and managing delivery partnerships that strengthen proposals, enhance service quality and deliver value for Catch22.
  • Providing leadership and assurance throughout the bid lifecycle, ensuring effective governance, compliance and proactive risk management.
  • Contributing to a culture of continuous improvement, championing innovation and adopting new approaches and technologies that enhance bid quality and team effectiveness.

For full role requirements, please read the Job Description and Person Specification.

We are looking for highly motivated, results-driven professional who brings:

  • Proven experience leading successful high-value or complex bids, proposals or projects.
  • Exceptional writing, communication and stakeholder engagement skills.
  • A track record of securing six-figure public sector contracts and/or grant funding.
  • Experience developing service solutions and funding propositions with operational teams, partners and stakeholders, including facilitating workshops.
  • Strong commercial awareness and a good understanding of the business development lifecycle.
  • Knowledge of one or more of Catch22's core service areas, including education, justice, employability, health, or victims and exploitation services.
  • Confidence using technology, CRM systems and data to improve performance and effectiveness.
  • An undergraduate degree, project management qualification, or equivalent relevant experience.
  • A commitment to inclusion, equity and belonging, fostering positive and respectful working relationships.
  • Willingness to travel across the UK to engage with colleagues, partners, commissioners and sector stakeholders.

Salary: £44,000 - £48,000
Contract: Permanent, full-time (37-hours per week)
Flexibility: Fully remote role (UK based), or with access to our central London office

Application Deadline: Midnight on Wednesday 26th August
Interviews: Thursday 10th and Friday 11th September

See the benefits of working for Catch22 here.

Unless otherwise stated, interviews will be arranged as suitable candidates are identified, so early application is strongly advised.

We aim to review applications as quickly as possible. However, due to the volume ofinterest we receive, we may not be able to contact all applicants individually. If you have not heard from us within two weeks of the closing date, please assume that your application has not been successful this time.

At Catch22 we value equality, diversity and inclusion. We are wholeheartedly committed to the principle of equality of opportunity, both as an employer and as a provider of services. Diversity and Inclusion is part of what we do every day, working to deliver our vision to build a strong society where everyone has good people around them, a purpose, and a good place to live.

Catch22 is committed to rigorous safeguarding and safer recruitment practices; ensuring that every individual within the organisation has been safely and appropriately checked.

Please note, we will conduct an online search as part of our due dilligence checks for successful candidate(s). This will involve a search of all publicly available information online and in social media.

Catch22’s Commitment to Ban the Box

Catch22 is proud to have “Banned the Box”. This means that we do not ask for candidates to disclose criminal convictions at the application stage. Instead, we invite disclosures at interview stage, and encourage them at the offer stage. Please see our statement of commitment on hiring people with convictions for more information.

Catch22 exists to help build a society where everyone has a good place to live, good people around them, and a fulfilling purpose. We call these our '3Ps'. We achieve this in two ways. First we improve lives on the frontline through delivery of public services. Secondly, we use our knowledge to change 'the system', to fix the complex web that can trap and disempower those it was set up to help. With the heart of a charity and the mindset of a business, we are uniquely placed to deliver on this challenging agenda.

About IXOPAY

IXOPAY is the enterprise-grade global payment infrastructure platform built for the era of agentic commerce. We equip merchants and enterprises with AI-driven intelligence, payment orchestration, advanced tokenization, and the tools to optimize every stage of the payments journey.

From intelligent routing and compliance to customizable modules and enterprise-scale orchestration, IXOPAY helps businesses integrate faster, improve payment performance, and expand globally with confidence.

At IXOPAY, our people are our greatest strength. Our collaborative culture is built on shared values that guide how we work, innovate, and support our customers.

About the Role

We're looking for a Senior Software Engineer to join our Engineering team and help build the backend foundation of IXOPAY's next-generation, AI-first payment orchestration platform.

In this hands-on role, you'll design and build the services that power intelligent payment routing, connector management, token intelligence, and platform configuration. You'll work on complex, high-scale systems that enable merchants to optimize payment performance while building secure, extensible infrastructure for the future of payments.

You'll collaborate closely with Product, AI, and Engineering teams, mentor junior engineers, and play a key role in shaping the architecture of a platform used by global enterprise customers.

What You'll Do

  • Design, build, and maintain scalable backend services using C# and .NET.

  • Develop the core infrastructure that powers payment routing, connector management, and platform configuration.

  • Design secure, extensible APIs that support both customer-facing applications and AI-powered workflows.

  • Build reliable, observable services that process high-volume payment transactions with performance and resilience in mind.

  • Collaborate with Product and AI teams to translate business requirements into scalable technical solutions.

  • Contribute to platform architecture, engineering standards, and technical decision-making.

  • Mentor junior engineers through code reviews, design discussions, and day-to-day technical guidance.

  • Continuously improve system performance, security, reliability, and developer experience.

What You'll Bring

Required

  • 5+ years of experience building production backend services.

  • Strong experience with C# and the .NET ecosystem.

  • Experience designing and building RESTful and/or event-driven APIs.

  • Strong understanding of relational databases, data modelling, and distributed systems.

  • Experience building secure, scalable cloud-based applications.

  • Excellent problem-solving, communication, and collaboration skills.

  • Ability to provide technical leadership while remaining hands-on in development.

Preferred

  • Experience in payments, FinTech, or other high-volume transaction processing environments.

  • Experience with Azure services such as App Configuration and Key Vault.

  • Knowledge of payment routing, PSP integrations, tokenization, or payment orchestration platforms.

  • Experience building APIs or services that integrate with AI or LLM-based applications.

  • Familiarity with plugin or adapter architectures and extensible platform design.

  • Understanding of PCI DSS, credential management, and payment security best practices.

  • Experience mentoring engineers in an agile development environment.

Why Join IXOPAY?

At IXOPAY, you'll help define the architecture behind the next generation of enterprise payment infrastructure. You'll work on technically challenging problems at the intersection of distributed systems, AI, and global payments while collaborating with a small, highly experienced engineering team where your contributions have a direct impact.

We offer:

  • Competitive salary and benefits

  • Professional growth and development opportunities

  • A collaborative, supportive engineering culture

  • The opportunity to shape a modern AI-first platform from the ground up

  • Medical, Dental, and Vision Insurance

  • Flexible Spending Account (FSA) and Health Savings Account (HSA)

Our Commitment to Inclusion

We know great candidates don't always meet every qualification. If you're excited about this opportunity, we encourage you to apply - we'd love to hear what you can bring to IXOPAY. What Makes an IXOPAYer? We are a global team bound by one standard, where every voice matters and initiative drives real change. We thrive on progress over perfection - choosing direction over motion, working smart with modern tech and AI, and constantly learning through continuous iteration. If you are tenaciously curious, empowered to take ownership, and passionate about delivering customer-first solutions in the fast-paced world of global payments, you’ll fit right in.

raw.description:
Omada Health is on a mission to bend the curve of chronic disease.

Job overview:

Omada is hiring a Customer Experience Enablement Senior Manager to strengthen how Customer Success Managers (CSMs) show up in front of customers, customized to their size and service level. This role is responsible for translating CX goals, field feedback, and business priorities into enablement strategy, high-value resources, and scalable systems that improve effectiveness in client-facing work.

Approximately half of the role should focus on strategic enablement: identifying the highest-leverage opportunities to improve CX effectiveness, shaping priorities and narratives, and ensuring enablement efforts directly support how CSMs manage and grow their books of business. The other half of the role should focus on scaling core enablement operations through systems thinking, process design, and AI-enabled workflows. This includes improving and modernizing foundational enablement infrastructure such as knowledge management, team communications, enablement intake, resource discoverability, and self-serve support so that the function scales efficiently without relying on high-touch project management.

About you:

You are an experienced enablement leader who uses customer and CSM feedback to identify the highest‑leverage priorities and adjust them as business needs evolve. You have a strong track record of applying AI and automation to reduce manual work, improve scale, and free up time for more strategic enablement. You thrive in highly collaborative, cross‑functional environments and are effective at influencing stakeholders across teams. You have successfully enabled customer‑facing teams that support multiple complex products, navigate varied rules of engagement, and serve diverse buyer types across the customer lifecycle.

Your impact:

  • Own a clear enablement roadmap tied to CX goals, team effectiveness, and customer-facing outcomes.
  • Translate CSM pain points, voice of customer themes, and business priorities into actionable enablement strategies, tools, narratives, and guidance.
  • Partner with PMM, Clinical, Product, Analytics, Client Operations, and CX leadership to identify where enablement can most directly improve customer conversations, book management, retention, and growth.
  • Shape strategic content and frameworks that help CSMs communicate value consistently and confidently across the customer journey.
  • Bring a clear point of view on what work should be prioritized, deprioritized, automated, or transitioned in order to keep the function focused on high-impact enablement.
  • Define success measures for enablement work and use feedback, usage patterns, and business context to continuously refine priorities.
  • Identify opportunities to use AI and automation to reduce low-value manual work across knowledge management, communications, intake triage, recurring content updates, and resource maintenance.
  • Create self-serve tools, repeatable workflows, and clear decision pathways so CX teammates can more easily find answers, access resources, and understand what matters most.

Evaluation Criteria:

  • 6–8+ years of customer success enablement, sales/revenue enablement, customer success operations, or related experience, with deeper experience in enablement than in general project management.
  • Proven ability to break down ambiguous business problems into clear priorities, practical solutions, and scalable enablement strategies.
  • Demonstrated success translating customer, CSM, and business feedback into roadmaps, resources, and guidance that improve field effectiveness.
  • Strong ownership mindset with the ability to operate autonomously and balance strategic thinking with operational execution in a fast-paced environment.
  • Clear communicator with strong professional presence, listening skills, and the ability to influence cross-functional stakeholders and senior leaders.
  • Experience using AI, automation, or systems thinking to reduce manual work, improve scale, and increase team efficiency.

You will love this job if you:

  • Have successfully enabled teams working across multiple complex products, varied rules of engagement, and different buyer types.
  • Enjoy turning ambiguity into structure, strategy, and practical guidance
  • Are energized by using AI or automation to streamline repetitive work and create more space for strategic impact.
  • Enjoy highly collaborative, cross-functional work and are effective at partnering with leaders across functions.
  • Have a background or interest in health technology, digital health, or telemedicine.
  • Have strong written and verbal communication skills and can simplify complex information for busy teams.

Benefits:

  • Competitive salary with generous annual cash bonus
  • Equity grants
  • Employee stock purchasing plan (ESPP)
  • Remote first work from home culture
  • Flexible Time Off to help you rest, recharge, and connect with loved ones
  • Generous parental leave
  • Health, dental, and vision insurance (and above market employer contributions)
  • 401k retirement savings plan
  • Lifestyle Spending Account (LSA)
  • Mental Health Support Solutions
  • ...and more!

It takes a village to change health care. As we build together toward our mission, we strive to embody the following values in our day-to-day work. We hope these hold meaning for you as well as you consider Omada!

  • Cultivate Trust. We listen closely and we operate with kindness. We provide respectful and candid feedback to each other.
  • Seek Context. We ask to understand and we build connections. We do our research up front to move faster down the road.
  • Act Boldly. We innovate daily to solve problems, improve processes, and find new opportunities for our members and customers.
  • Deliver Results. We reward impact above output. We set a high bar, we’re not afraid to fail, and we take pride in our work.
  • Succeed Together. We prioritize Omada’s progress above team or individual. We have fun as we get stuff done, and we celebrate together.
  • Remember Why We’re Here. We push through the challenges of changing health care because we know the destination is worth it.

About Omada Health: Omada Health (Nasdaq: OMDA) is reverse engineering the way healthcare is delivered in America, putting the space between doctor visits–where health is won or lost–at the center of care. Today's healthcare system poorly serves chronic conditions that require ongoing support outside of the exam room, like obesity, diabetes, hypertension, cholesterol, and musculoskeletal conditions. Omada’s virtual-first model combines human-led care teams, connected devices, and AI-enabled technology to deliver personalized care at scale, including support for GLP-1 therapy. Omada has served more than two million members since launch across 2,000+ employers, health plans, pharmacy benefit managers, and health systems. Learn more at omadahealth.com.

Omada is thrilled to share that we’ve been certified as a Great Place to Work! Please click here for more information.

We carefully hire the best talent we can find, which means actively seeking diversity of beliefs, backgrounds, education, and ways of thinking. We strive to build an inclusive culture where differences are celebrated and leveraged to inform better design and business decisions. Omada is proud to be an equal opportunity workplace and affirmative action employer. We are committed to equal opportunity regardless of race, color, religion, sex, gender identity, national origin, ancestry, citizenship, age, physical or mental disability, legally protected medical condition, family care status, military or veteran status, marital status, domestic partner status, sexual orientation, or any other basis protected by local, state, or federal laws. Pursuant to the San Francisco Fair Chance Ordinance, we will consider for employment qualified applicants with arrest and conviction records.

Network Engineer – Remote

Position Type: Full-Time, Remote
Location: Remote
Working Hours: U.S. Business Hours (Flexibility required for on-call support and critical incidents)

About the Role

At Pavago, one of our clients is hiring a Network Engineer to design, maintain, secure, and optimize enterprise network infrastructure across client environments.

This is not a helpdesk or support-only role. You’ll take ownership of network reliability, performance, and security across enterprise environments while supporting both day-to-day operations and long-term infrastructure initiatives.

Working across routing, switching, firewalls, VPNs, monitoring systems, and hybrid cloud environments, you’ll ensure network infrastructure remains stable, secure, scalable, and highly available.

If you enjoy solving complex networking challenges, improving infrastructure, and maintaining mission-critical systems, this role is for you.

Responsibilities

Network Infrastructure & Configuration

  • Configure, maintain, and optimize enterprise network infrastructure, including routers, switches, firewalls, and VPNs.
  • Implement and manage:
    • VLANs
    • QoS
    • VPN tunnels
    • Access Control Lists (ACLs)
    • Routing protocols including OSPF, BGP, and EIGRP
  • Perform firmware upgrades, patching, and infrastructure maintenance.
  • Support network expansion projects, migrations, and infrastructure upgrades.
  • Maintain reliable connectivity across multi-site and hybrid environments.

Network Monitoring & Troubleshooting

  • Monitor network health using tools such as:
    • SolarWinds
    • PRTG
    • Nagios
    • Zabbix
  • Diagnose and resolve latency, packet loss, DNS, routing, and connectivity issues.
  • Troubleshoot escalated incidents using tools such as Wireshark and TCPdump.
  • Perform root-cause analysis and implement long-term preventive solutions.
  • Participate in on-call support and respond to critical network incidents when required.

Network Security & Compliance

  • Configure and maintain firewall environments including:
    • Cisco
    • Palo Alto
    • Fortinet
    • Juniper
  • Implement network segmentation, ACLs, and security policies.
  • Support compliance initiatives related to:
    • PCI-DSS
    • HIPAA
    • SOX
    • GDPR
  • Assist with Zero Trust networking and secure remote access implementations.
  • Maintain a secure, resilient, and well-governed network infrastructure.

Performance Optimization & Reliability

  • Perform bandwidth utilization analysis and capacity planning.
  • Optimize network performance through redundancy, failover, and load balancing.
  • Maintain high-availability infrastructure across enterprise environments.
  • Identify bottlenecks and recommend scalable infrastructure improvements.
  • Support cloud networking integrations across AWS, Azure, and hybrid environments.

Documentation & Operational Governance

  • Maintain accurate network diagrams, topology maps, SOPs, and technical documentation.
  • Document infrastructure changes following structured change management processes.
  • Keep configurations, procedures, and documentation organized and audit-ready.
  • Collaborate closely with infrastructure, cloud, security, and DevOps teams on network initiatives.

What Makes You a Great Fit

  • You have a strong troubleshooting mindset and remain calm during critical incidents.
  • You proactively identify and resolve infrastructure risks.
  • You communicate technical concepts clearly to both technical and non-technical stakeholders.
  • You maintain high standards for documentation and operational excellence.
  • You work independently while collaborating effectively within remote teams.
  • You take ownership of infrastructure reliability and long-term improvements.

Required Experience & Skills

  • 3+ years of professional Network Engineering experience.
  • Hands-on experience managing enterprise networking environments.
  • Strong knowledge of:
    • OSPF
    • BGP
    • EIGRP
  • Experience configuring:
    • Routers
    • Switches
    • Firewalls
    • VPN environments
  • Experience with network monitoring and troubleshooting platforms.
  • Strong experience with Cisco networking environments or equivalent enterprise platforms.
  • Solid understanding of:
    • TCP/IP

raw.description:
About the role

Hyperion Quantitative Strategies is an AI-native systematic fund built end to end by its own engineering team. Kubernetes on Google Cloud, Terraform-managed infrastructure, automated pipelines pulling market data across equities, options, index options, volatility and crypto at minute and daily resolution, a proprietary backtesting engine, and a live trading book. The fund is already in discussions that would take it to several hundred million dollars in assets under management, and the ambition is a firm built in the spirit of Renaissance Technologies, with AI core to how it operates rather than a layer sitting on top.

The engineering bench is deliberately small and senior. One engineer deep in backtesting and infrastructure, one in agentic systems and the data lake, one in data engineering — and the CTO owning the quantitative layer above them. This role sits across the whole platform: cloud architecture, data pipelines, production reliability and live-system ownership, in one senior individual contributor seat. Infrastructure is the floor, not the ceiling. You design the systems, you run them, and the calls about where the platform goes next are yours to make.

You will report directly to the CTO and co-founder. Copenhagen is the preferred base; strong candidates in CET-compatible European time zones are considered. Hyperion is built inside the Bifrost Studios portfolio, and Bifrost Studios is running this search.

What you'll do

  • Own and evolve the Kubernetes platform on Google Cloud (GKE) through Terraform, with infrastructure as code treated as an engineering discipline rather than a collection of scripts.
  • Build and operate the pipelines that ingest market data from multiple vendors — normalisation, validation and strict format compliance included — so the trading engine always has numbers it can rely on.
  • Own deployment, monitoring, alerting and incident response for the live trading systems, so problems in the running book surface early and get resolved fast.
  • Own the relational and analytical databases behind trading and research: schema design, performance, operations, and fault-tolerant, high-availability architecture where it earns its place.
  • Steward the integrations with external data providers and broker connectivity, and treat the proprietary data as a long-term asset — a number pulled two years from now should still be safe to trade on.
  • Cut operational toil through automation, so the platform needs progressively less manual intervention as it matures.
  • Work directly alongside the CTO and the quant and data engineering team, acting as the clear owner the moment something breaks during market hours.

Twelve months in, success looks like this: the research and quant team has stopped thinking about infrastructure because it just stays reliable.

What we're looking for

  • End-to-end production ownership. You have owned a production infrastructure and data platform somewhere reliability genuinely mattered — not a narrow slice of a large platform team, and not consuming infrastructure somebody else ran. This is the filter. It typically shows up somewhere between five and twelve years in, but we do not filter on years.
  • Kubernetes, GCP and Terraform in production, with infrastructure as code held as an engineering discipline.
  • A track record of building reliable, automated pipelines from messy external sources, with real familiarity with vendor quirks, corporate actions, adjustments and timezone handling.
  • Strong Python and Java. JavaScript is welcome.
  • Solid relational database skills across schema design, performance and operations, plus DevOps depth: CI/CD, observability, on-call practice and fault-tolerant architecture.
  • Genuinely AI-native. You use AI coding agents as standard practice, not as something you are warming up to, and you can explain every line that ships and what it does to the system.
  • A real interest in markets. Prior experience with trading or market data systems is a meaningful plus. A finance background is not required.
  • Based in Copenhagen or within a CET-compatible European time zone.

About Bifrost Studios

Bifrost Studios builds and backs ambitious technology businesses, providing portfolio companies with the operational, engineering and sourcing infrastructure to grow with intent. Hyperion Quantitative Strategies is one of those businesses — and this search is being run directly by the Bifrost Studios team on Hyperion's behalf.

If you are a senior engineer who wants full ownership of a live, consequential platform at the earliest stage where the decisions you make now are the ones it runs on for years, we would like to hear from you.

Process: Intro call with the recruiter → technical deep dive with the CTO → interview with the quant and engineering team → case assessment and psychometrics → references and offer.

Copenhagen, Denmark — CET-compatible European time zones considered. Full-time employee.

Software Verification & QA Specialist

Are you an experienced Software Verification & QA Specialist ready to take on a challenging and rewarding role? We are looking for a technically strong professional with sharp problem-solving skills and a genuine passion for delivering high-quality software. In this role, you will combine analytical thinking with creativity, collaborate closely with cross-functional teams, and play a key part in ensuring excellence across our products.

We’re accepting applications over the next two months and will appoint the right candidate as soon as we find the ideal fit.

About the Role

The main focus of this role is to ensure the integrity and reliability of our customers' software through verification processes. This role involves analyzing technical documentation, executing successful software builds in various programming languages, and validating software functionality against specified requirements. Additionally, you will be involved in conducting thorough testing of various scenarios, employing both manual and automated testing approaches. Your meticulous attention to detail will enable you to identify and report any bugs or glitches discovered during testing.

What You’ll Be Doing

Software Verification

  • Conduct verification of customer software using provided technical documentation

  • Achieve software builds across various programming languages

  • Identify, diagnose, and resolve build issues, ensuring software meets quality standards

Quality Assurance & Testing

  • Conduct end-to-end testing of application features across multiple scenarios

  • Use both manual and automated testing methods to validate functionality

  • Identify, document, and report bugs or inconsistencies to ensure a high-quality user experience

Technical Analysis and Problem Solving

  • Analyze software requirements and technical documentation to understand build processes and dependencies

Collaboration and Communication

  • Communicate effectively with team members and clients to understand requirements and provide updates

Continuous Learning and Improvement

  • Stay updated with emerging technologies and programming languages relevant to software verification

  • Contribute to the continuous improvement of verification processes and practices

Additional Backend, Frontend, and DevOps Tasks

  • Assist in backend and frontend development tasks as required

  • Participate in DevOps activities, including CI/CD pipeline development and maintenance

Why Codekeeper?

We were founded by tech industry professionals to revolutionize software escrow for the cloud era. We offer state-of-the-art software escrow solutions that mitigate third-party risks in business operations. As a remote-first company with a central office in The Hague, we prioritize a healthy, resilient organization to support the development of our robust app.

🌐

What You Can Expect

  • Passionate and fun-loving colleagues

  • Startup mindset with ample opportunities for growth

  • Regular team activities and gatherings

  • Comprehensive onboarding process with a dedicated ramp-up period

  • A supportive team that values open communication and direct feedback

  • A chance to excel in your career and make a difference

About You

  • 3+ years development / DevOps experience

  • 2+ years of experience with Linux, Windows and Mac environment fundamentals

  • Basic understanding of popular backend languages (Python, Java, NodeJS and PHP)

  • Prior experience or understanding of database- and server configuration (MongoDB, SQL, MySQL)

  • Prior experience or understanding of Git

  • Basic knowledge of front-end languages HTML, CSS, and JavaScript beneficial

  • Basic knowledge of AWS technologies beneficial

  • Basic knowledge of API configuration beneficial

  • Experience with various build tools, like (but not specifically) msbuild, webpack, maven, and others of the type beneficial

Additional Requirements

  • Technical Expertise: Proficiency in multiple programming languages and software development tools

  • Analytical Skills: Strong ability to analyze technical documentation and identify key requirements

  • Problem-Solving: Excellent problem-solving abilities to diagnose and resolve complex software issues

  • Communication: Effective communication skills, both verbal and written, for collaborating with teams and clients

  • Adaptability: Ability to adapt to various programming environments and quickly learn new technologies

  • Teamwork: Strong team player with the ability to work in cross-functional teams

  • Time Management: Excellent organizational and time-management skills, with the ability to handle multiple tasks simultaneously

raw.description:
Noctrix Health is redefining the treatment of chronic neurological disorders with clinically validated therapeutic wearables. Our team of medical device specialists, neuroscientists, and consumer electronics engineers is dedicated to delivering prescription-grade therapy with an outstanding user experience. We have pioneered the world’s first drug-free wearable therapy, clinically proven to alleviate symptoms in adults with drug-resistant Restless Legs Syndrome (RLS). Be part of our mission to transform healthcare, improve lives, and drive meaningful change with Noctrix Health.

The Patient Access Appeals Case Manager is responsible for supporting patients through the denial and appeal process, coordinating with healthcare providers, insurance companies, and patients to ensure seamless access to our innovative DME device. This position will play a supportive role in ensuring the successful commercialization of our product by developing and executing reimbursement strategies, establishing relationships with payers, and navigating the complex healthcare reimbursement landscape.

Responsibilities:

  • Support patients, healthcare providers, and insurance companies regarding access and reimbursement for our novel DME device
  • Collaborate with healthcare providers to obtain necessary documentation and clinical information for insurance claims and prior authorization requests
  • Coordinate with insurance companies to ensure timely and accurate processing of claims and prior authorization requests
  • Stay up to date with insurance policies, coverage criteria, and reimbursement guidelines to provide accurate information and assist in obtaining coverage for patients.
  • Help to identify and address any access or reimbursement challenges, working closely with cross-functional teams to develop solutions
  • Provide exceptional customer service to patients, healthcare providers, and insurance companies, addressing inquiries and resolving any access-related issues.
  • Collaborate with internal stakeholders to develop training materials, tools, and resources for healthcare providers and patients to ensure a smooth access process
  • Assess incoming denials and log in the database to identify trends in denials, new medical policies, as well as successful talk tracks and language used in successful appeals
  • Continuously evaluate and enhance the commercial appeals process for efficiency and effectiveness
  • Identify trends in appeals and provide insights to management for process optimization, and implement best practices and industry benchmarks to drive improvements in the appeals resolution workflow
  • Generate regular reports on appeal metrics, including volumes, resolution times, and outcomes

Requirements:

  • BA/BS degree in business, healthcare or marketing fields required or equivalent experience
  • 2+ years of healthcare sector (pharmaceutical and medical device)
  • 1+ years in medical device reimbursement involving DME products
  • Experience leading projects and teams of reimbursement and billing professionals
  • Excellent collaboration skills and can-do attitude
  • Excellent presentation and communication skills, with a strong emphasis on written communication
  • Excellent analytical abilities

Preferable:

  • Experience in appeals, IRO, and ALJ process
  • Experience with Insurance Complaints and State Fair Hearings

About the job:

The Senior Architect is responsible for working independently and leading the resolution of varied and non-routine complex technical requirements, exercising independent judgment and creative solutioning, to achieve functional and non-functional targets and goals. This role supports the development and review of complex and compelling task lists, leads complex customer engagements, and mentors junior team members. The Senior Architect may coordinate the activities of other team members (team lead) to ensure successful completion of projects and assignments. This role is responsible for mentoring and providing guidance and advice to new team members.

What you will do:

  • Supports the development and review of complex task lists, providing expert guidance on project scoping and ensuring alignment with customer requirements and business objectives.

  • Leads multiple standard engagements or multiple work streams on a complex engagement acting as a trusted advisor and influencing solution adoption.

  • Guides pilot and production deployments, ensuring successful implementation and integration of Red Hat solutions.

  • Mentors and provides guidance to junior team members, fostering their professional development and ensuring consistent quality of service delivery.

  • Proactively identifies and addresses potential technical challenges, developing creative and compelling solutions to mitigate risks and ensure project success.

  • Champions the value of the Red Hat Services Portfolio, including Consulting, Training, and Technical Account Managers and integrating it strategically into customer solutions.

  • Provides expert customer feedback to internal teams, influencing product development and service enhancements.

  • Leads internal initiatives that foster innovation, efficiency, and growth within the Services business.

What you will bring:

  • Services Solution Architecture: Expertly designs and implements complex solutions that contribute to revenue growth.

  • Consultative Selling: Leads consultative engagements, understanding complex business challenges, and develops tailored solutions.

  • Technical Requirements Gathering: Expertly elicits and analyzes complex functional and non-functional requirements and translates them into actionable solutions.

  • Level of Effort Estimation (LOE): Expertly assesses the complexity and time required for various tasks, using past experiences and relevant metrics to provide accurate LOE estimates.

  • Red Hat Product Knowledge: Expert understanding of Red Hat's product portfolio and its application in diverse environments.

  • Product Demonstrations: Delivers compelling presentations and solution demonstrations to diverse audiences.

  • Mentorship: Guides and supports the development of junior team members.

The salary range for this position is $118,600.00 - $277,350.00. Actual offer will be based on your qualifications.

Pay Transparency

Red Hat determines compensation based on several factors including but not limited to job location, experience, applicable skills and training, external market value, and internal pay equity. Annual salary is one component of Red Hat’s compensation package. This position may also be eligible for bonus, commission, and/or equity. For positions with Remote-US locations, the actual salary range for the position may differ based on location but will be commensurate with job duties and relevant work experience.

About Red Hat

Red Hat is the world’s leading provider of enterpriseopen source software solutions, using a community-powered approach to deliver high-performing Linux, cloud, container, and Kubernetes technologies. Spread across 40+ countries, our associates work flexibly across work environments, from in-office, to office-flex, to fully remote, depending on the requirements of their role. Red Hatters are encouraged to bring their best ideas, no matter their title or tenure. We're a leader in open source because of our open and inclusive environment. We hire creative, passionate people ready to contribute their ideas, help solve complex problems, and make an impact.

Benefits
● Comprehensive medical, dental, and vision coverage
● Flexible Spending Account - healthcare and dependent care
● Health Savings Account - high deductible medical plan
● Retirement 401(k) with employer match

● Paid time off and holidays

● Paid parental leave plans for all new parents
● Leave benefits including disability, paid family medical leave, and paid military leave
● Additional benefits including employee stock purchase plan, family planning reimbursement, tuition reimbursement, transportation expense account, employee assistance program, and more!

Note: These benefits are only applicable to full time, permanent associates at Red Hat located in the United States.

Inclusion at Red Hat
Red Hat’s culture is built on the open source principles of transparency, collaboration, and inclusion, where the best ideas can come from anywhere and anyone. When this is realized, it empowers people from different backgrounds, perspectives, and experiences to come together to share ideas, challenge the status quo, and drive innovation. Our aspiration is that everyone experiences this culture with equal opportunity and access, and that all voices are not only heard but also celebrated. We hope you will join our celebration, and we welcome and encourage applicants from all the beautiful dimensions that compose our global village.

Equal Opportunity Policy (EEO)
Red Hat is proud to be an equal opportunity workplace and an affirmative action employer. We review applications for employment without regard to their race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, ancestry, citizenship, age, veteran status, genetic information, physical or mental disability, medical condition, marital status, or any other basis prohibited by law.


Red Hat does not seek or accept unsolicited resumes or CVs from recruitment agencies. We are not responsible for, and will not pay, any fees, commissions, or any other payment related to unsolicited resumes or CVs except as required in a written contract between Red Hat and the recruitment agency or party requesting payment of a fee.

Red Hat supports individuals with disabilities and provides reasonable accommodations to job applicants. If you need assistance completing our online job application, email . General inquiries, such as those regarding the status of a job application, will not receive a reply.

CNBC’s Disruptor 50 for five years.
CNBC’s World's Top Fintech Companies for two consecutive years.
Forbes’ Fintech 50 list for nine consecutive years.
Visionary investors, persuaded by the economic power of the global majority, have committed half a billion dollars in equity and debt to Tala's success.

Most Talazens join us because they connect with our mission. If you are energized by the impact you can make at Tala, we’d love to hear from you!

  • Manage daily interactions and engagements across social media platforms.
  • Drive growth through follower acquisition, engagement, and community management.
  • Identify and explore new social media channels and trends to expand our online presence.
  • Develop and curate engaging content for social media platforms.
  • Assist in the creation and editing of written, video, and graphic content.
  • Attend events and produce live social media content.
  • Maintain unified brand voice across different social media channels
  • Monitor social media channels for industry trends.
  • Review analytics and create reports on key metrics.

What You'll Need

  • Minimum of 5 years of experience in social media marketing, community management, content management or a similar role.
  • In-depth knowledge of social media trends and platforms.
  • Impeccable time management skills with the ability to organize and prioritize and meet deadlines
  • Proven experience in developing successful social media campaigns.
  • Fluent in English (spoken and written) B2/C1 preferred
  • Track record of delivering projects and impact in a fast-paced environment.

Nice to Have

  • Experience in the fintech industry, hospitality, advertising or related fields.
  • Certificates of social media training from software like Facebook Blueprint, TikTok, Google University, Coursera, Domestika and/or similar

raw.description:
This is a remote position.

Strategy & Transformation Delivery Regional Lead

Location: Virtual-first (U.S.-based) | Remote position with travel requirements varying by engagement, up to 50% to client sites in your region. Hiring regionally to serve a global customer base, with priority given to candidates in the Americas and EMEA.
Type: Full-time or Contract-to-Hire

About Global Transformation Group

Global Transformation Group is the consulting sister organization of PMO Strategies, creators of the IMPACT Engine System™ and host of the PMO Strategies Podcast. With shared ownership, the two organizations operate collaboratively—ensuring our teams have access to the best training, tools, and resources to deliver high-IMPACT outcomes for our clients and students.

At Global Transformation Group, we turn vision into value. Our mission is to help forward-thinking organizations close the gap between strategy design and execution using the IMPACT Engine System™—a proven transformation framework that builds internal capability, accelerates performance, and delivers measurable business outcomes.

We help organizations accelerate strategy delivery by operating at the intersection of strategy, operations, and change. From ambitious mid-sized companies to global enterprises, we enable clients to organize, operate, and deliver differently—so they can lead with greater agility, clarity, and confidence.

About the Role

We’re looking for a Regional Delivery Lead—a highly experienced, strategy-minded consultant who can lead complex transformation engagements, guide enterprise teams, and coach leaders to operate as high-performing business navigators. You will deliver and scale the IMPACT Engine System™ across client organizations, building lasting value from the inside out.

This is a contract-to-permanent role designed for professionals who want to have true ownership in transformation—not just advise, but implement. You’ll work shoulder-to-shoulder with executives to build high-IMPACT organizations that deliver on what matters most.

What You’ll Do

Client Delivery & Strategic Leadership

  • Lead full lifecycle implementation of PMO and transformation work across a portfolio of clients and industries, delivering tangible strategic value.
  • Conduct discovery and business alignment sessions that clarify strategic priorities, reveal root causes, and ensure the right focus areas.
  • Build and validate business cases, transformation roadmaps, and service portfolios that guide organizational change and stakeholder buy-in.
  • Design and drive transformation programs that include operational improvements, delivery capability building, KPI implementation, and process optimization.
  • Facilitate strategic workshops and decision sessions that accelerate alignment, build trust, and unlock forward momentum.

Operationalize Strategy Execution

  • Define and evolve PMO and transformation office capabilities to become agile, outcome-focused delivery engines.
  • Establish lean governance structures and performance-driven portfolio management practices that increase speed and accountability.
  • Implement scalable, high-IMPACT solutions that quickly demonstrate business value and build credibility from day one.

Coaching & Change Enablement

  • Coach transformation teams and executives to embrace an agile, business-first delivery mindset rooted in a value-focused approach.
  • Assess and enable change readiness with cultural sensitivity, helping clients lead change with—not to—their people.
  • Model and mentor strategic thinking and adaptive leadership while balancing stakeholder coaching with hands-on delivery.
  • Mentor client-side leaders to become self-sustaining IMPACT Drivers, capable of driving change long after our engagement ends.
  • Lead junior consultants and internal delivery staff, fostering high-performance mindsets and collaborative delivery excellence.

Performance & Continuous Improvement

  • Define and implement KPI tracking systems that align with value realization frameworks—not just outputs, but true business impact.
  • Conduct delivery retrospectives and lessons learned to inform future iterations and optimize client performance.
  • Evolve client impact roadmaps quarterly, guiding the next cycle of value creation based on real results, not theoretical goals.
  • Contribute to internal innovation, advancing our methodology, content, and tools as part of our collective consulting brain trust.

What You Bring

  • 8–12+ years of experience in PMO, strategy execution, or transformation delivery roles—ideally with a consulting or advisory background.
  • Deep expertise in program/portfolio management, organizational change, and transformation leadership across multiple functions.
  • Exceptional facilitation and executive communication skills, with the ability to guide complex stakeholder environments.
  • Strong grounding in organizational change management, with proven strategies for aligning people, culture, and systems during transformation.
  • Experience across methodologies and tools (e.g., Agile, SAFe, TOC, Waterfall, Lean, Planview, Planisware, Six Sigma).
  • PMP, PgMP, or similar certifications preferred; Prosci or change certifications a strong plus.
  • IMPACT Engine System™ Certification preferred (support provided if not already certified).
  • Consulting-firm experience preferred, particularly in client-facing transformation roles or cross-functional engagements.
  • Systems thinker and fast synthesizer, with the ability to go from ambiguity to clarity and from vision to execution rapidly.

Ideal Candidate

You are a strategic operator who thrives on solving messy problems, simplifying complexity, and enabling real business outcomes. You connect dots others miss, build momentum quickly, and lead with both confidence and empathy. You don’t just “manage projects”—you shape organizations.

We operate like a start-up inside a mature consulting firm: high trust, low politics, and obsessed with impact. If you want autonomy, collaboration, and a platform to do the best work of your career—this is your seat.

Why Join Us (Instead of a Big Firm)?

Think of us as what the big consulting companies could be—with soul.

  • You implement transformation, not just recommend it.
  • No armies of analysts, no layers of red tape. You work directly with executives and our leadership team.
  • You grow your own thought leadership, not just your billing hours.
  • You’ll help refine the system, not just follow one.
  • You’ll work on what matters. High-impact transformation. Strategic enablement. Long-term capability building.

Career Growth & Development

  • Advance quickly into more senior roles or client advisory positions as you demonstrate mastery.
  • Become a Strategy Navigator™, our highest-tier designation for advisors who shape strategy, not just delivery.
  • Participate in internal innovation and thought leadership, including speaking, writing, and contributing to new IES tools and approaches.
  • Access IES certification, advanced coaching, and mastermind communities to stay sharp and continually evolve your own leadership.

Engagement Model

  • Contract-to-hire: Initial consulting engagement with a strong path to a permanent leadership position.
  • Virtual-first work model, with travel to client locations as needed.
  • Compensation aligned with experience and engagement scope, with opportunities to grow.

How to Apply

To apply, please submit your resume and a brief cover letter outlining:

  • Why you're excited to join Global Transformation Group, PMO Strategies sister company
  • Relevant experience aligned with this role
  • Your availability and compensation expectations

We’re building something meaningful—and we’re looking for people who are ready to make an IMPACT.

Does this role feel wonderful but a bit intimidating? If you have some, but not all the experience, please submit anyway, as we are going to have multiple PMO and transformation delivery roles. You can also check out our other postings, such as the Project Manager role, that might be a closer fit.

raw.description:
Principal AI Engineer
BuzzBoard · Remote (WFH) · Engineering / AIThe role
BuzzBoard builds AI products for the B2SMB market — helping agencies, media companies, and sellers understand small businesses and market to them at a level of personalization that wasn't previously economical. Our platform is built on frontier models end to end. Not AI features bolted onto a legacy product — the products are agent systems.
Our products span multi-agent marketing content generation, real-time AI voice intake, and pre- and post-sales intelligence for SMBs — Zylo, IRIS, Ignite, and Ember. They share a common internal pipeline for orchestration, retrieval, tool use, evaluation, and deployment.
This role owns the architecture underneath that pipeline. Not one feature — the shared layer every product depends on: how retrieval is built and measured, how agents reason and hold state and fail safely, which models run where and what happens when one degrades, how output quality is evaluated before it ships, and where the line sits between what a model decides and what deterministic code decides. You'll set that architecture, build the reusable patterns products inherit, guide the engineers implementing them, and own whether it holds up in production at volume.
It's a senior individual-contributor role. Two boundaries, stated plainly:
  • Not a research role. The deliverable is a shipped, reliable capability, not a paper or a demo.
  • Not a DevOps role. You need to be fluent in deployment and able to get a service into production, but full-time platform ownership sits elsewhere. Your center of gravity is AI system design.
If your GenAI experience is mostly notebooks and proofs of concept that never carried real traffic, this is not the role.
What you'll own
AI system architecture. Design the systems behind content generation, business intelligence, recommendations, and agentic workflows — including where the boundary sits between what a model decides and what deterministic code decides. Create reusable patterns, prompts, evaluation flows, and orchestration layers that hold up across products rather than being rebuilt per feature.
Agentic workflows. Lead the design of agents that reason, call tools and APIs, manage state, checkpoint, and hand tasks off cleanly. Build the guardrails that keep them grounded and predictable — the hard part is not making an agent act, it's making it fail safely and legibly when it's wrong.
Retrieval and model strategy. Design RAG pipelines end to end: chunking, embeddings, metadata, reranking, and retrieval evaluation that actually measures whether the right context arrived. Own model selection across ecosystems on the axes that matter — cost, latency, accuracy, reliability — and define the fallback and model-switching behavior for when a provider degrades.
Evaluation and quality. Stand up the evaluation frameworks that decide whether an AI output ships: output quality, edit ratio, hallucination rate, schema adherence, latency, failure rate, inference cost. Build regression testing so a prompt or model change can't silently break production. Turn “the output feels off” into a measured threshold.
Production readiness. Partner with engineering and platform teams so systems are deployable, observable, and maintainable. Package services (Python, FastAPI/Flask, Docker) when it's the fastest path, and diagnose the production failure modes specific to AI — rate limits, cost spikes, model failures, degraded output — rather than escalating them blind.
Technical leadership. Mentor GenAI engineers, review designs and prompts and workflows and evals, and translate product requirements into architecture with measurable acceptance criteria. Communicate the tradeoffs to engineers and to leadership in language each can act on.

What we're looking for
Required
  • 5+ years in engineering, AI, ML, or data-product work; 3+ years hands-on with GenAI / LLM systems
  • Production GenAI experience — non-negotiable. You have built or scaled systems that carried real traffic, and you can walk through one in detail: what broke, what it cost, what you changed.
  • Deep working knowledge of LLMs and SLMs: prompt engineering, structured outputs, tool and function calling
  • Hands-on with at least two major LLM ecosystems, and able to reason about the tradeoffs between them rather than defaulting to the one you know
  • RAG built for real: vector stores (Chroma, Pinecone, Weaviate, FAISS, or equivalent), embeddings, semantic search, and retrieval quality you've actually measured
  • Hands-on with at least one agentic framework (LangGraph, CrewAI, AutoGen, Semantic Kernel, or equivalent) and the underlying concepts — memory, state, tool integration, failure handling — well enough to move across frameworks
  • Strong Python; comfortable with REST APIs, Docker, a cloud platform, and basic CI/CD
  • Demonstrated evaluation work: regression testing, hallucination checks, schema validation, output scoring — you can define metrics for quality, reliability, cost, and business impact
  • Track record guiding a small team or owning AI architecture end to end
  • Comfort creating structure in a fast-moving environment with shifting requirements
Preferred
  • Fine-tuning or supervised training workflows
  • SLM and open-source model deployment; model serving with vLLM, Ollama, or TensorRT-LLM
  • Multimodal work across text, image, audio, or video
  • Kubernetes or serverless deployment
  • Evaluation/observability tooling — LangSmith, MLflow, Weights & Biases, or equivalent
  • Marketing technology, SMB intelligence, or content-automation domain experience
  • Responsible AI, privacy, security, and compliance practice
  • Experience scaling AI systems that generate high volumes of content, recommendations, or insights
What we care most about
  • You've built or scaled real GenAI systems, not just demos
  • You design AI workflows that are reliable, testable, and cost-aware from the start
  • You make practical model, prompt, retrieval, and architecture calls and can defend them
  • You know how to balance model intelligence against deterministic logic and engineering guardrails
  • You stay hands-on while guiding engineers — neither purely a manager nor purely an IC
  • You think past “which model” to the whole system around the model
What this role is not
  • Not a research or publications role
  • Not full-time DevOps or platform ownership
  • Not a role for someone whose GenAI track record is demos that never took production traffic
What we offer
  • Fully remote
  • A production GenAI foundation already carrying real volume — you scale it, you don't start from zero
  • Genuine architectural ownership over the agentic systems that come next
  • A small, high-context team that moves quickly and argues about the work
  • Real impact on small businesses
Apply if you've shipped GenAI systems that carried real traffic and you want to own the architecture of what comes next.

raw.description:
About Airship

Airship is trusted by world’s leading brands such as Alaska Airlines, BBC and The Home Depot to drive revenue growth and customer loyalty with exceptional cross-channel customer experiences. Today, brands are challenged to deliver seamless, unified customer experiences across a fragmented array of channels and devices— apps, websites, email, SMS, wallets and more.

Airship’s no-code, AI-powered platform was designed with non-technical, growth-focused teams in mind, making it easy to create, test and orchestrate hyper-personalized experiences across all channels. With the ability to easily enrich customer data and rapidly launch growth experiments, Airship enables brands to deliver consistent, meaningful interactions that accelerate conversion and foster deeper customer relationships.

We invite you to be part of our journey in building products and delivering services that touch millions of customers around the world every day.

To learn more about us, visit , read our blog or follow us on LinkedIn.

About Gummicube

Gummicube is a specialized division within Airship Group, Inc., focused exclusively on app discovery, App Store Optimization, mobile growth, and app store conversion. Gummicube helps brands grow high-quality mobile app audiences by improving visibility and conversion across the App Store and Google Play. Our work combines proprietary technology with hands-on strategy, analytics, creative testing, and client services. Gummicube serves apps of every size and category, including enterprise brands, high-growth startups, and new app launches.

Although Gummicube is part of Airship Group, this is a Gummicube-specific role. Candidates hired into this position will work with Gummicube's team, clients, services, and proprietary ASO technologies.
Gummicube's culture is entrepreneurial, collaborative, client-focused, and hands-on. We value people who are curious about mobile growth, comfortable working across functions, and motivated by helping customers improve performance through data-driven recommendations and disciplined execution.

For more information, visit

About the Role

At Gummicube, you will work in a focused, specialized business where app store performance, mobile growth, client outcomes, and data-driven execution are central to the work. Our teams are intentionally cross-functional, which means you'll often see how your work affects the full ASO process, including strategy, analytics, creative, client delivery, and product feedback. This is a good fit for someone who enjoys agency-style client work, fast-moving priorities, practical problem solving, and close collaboration with teammates across disciplines.

In this role, you will lead growth strategy and revenue expansion across a portfolio of ASO and mobile growth clients. You'll combine performance marketing expertise with consultative leadership to help clients achieve measurable results.

What You'll Do

  • Own client growth, retention, and revenue expansion for a portfolio of Gummicube accounts, using strategic planning and data-driven recommendations to deliver measurable business outcomes
  • Lead business reviews, quarterly planning sessions, and growth strategy presentations for your clients, translating complex performance data into clear, actionable recommendations
  • Mentor and develop Growth Managers, Analysts, and Specialists on your team, providing strategic guidance and career development support
  • Drive budget expansion and secure incremental investment opportunities by demonstrating value through forecasting, scenario planning, and financial modeling
  • Lead cross-functional initiatives across Paid Media, Business Development, and Account teams to align client strategy with Gummicube's ASO methodology and services
  • Improve operational excellence by developing processes, documentation, and best practices that raise the bar for the broader team
  • Use attribution platforms, analytics tools, and data visualization solutions to inform strategy and drive business decisions
  • Use AI-powered tools where appropriate to improve personal productivity, reporting efficiency, and strategic analysis

*Duties and responsibilities described are not a comprehensive list and additional tasks may be assigned from time to time; or the scope of the job may change as necessitated by business demands. Responsibilities may be amended at any time at the sole discretion of the Employer.

What We're Looking For

  • 7+ years of experience in growth marketing, performance marketing, user acquisition, digital marketing, or a related field
  • 2–3 years of experience leading client strategy, owning accounts, and managing teams
  • Experience managing $1M+ in annual media budget (or equivalent portfolio responsibility)
  • Track record of growing revenue, client spend, or portfolio value
  • Experience presenting performance results and strategy recommendations to executive stakeholders
  • Deep familiarity with digital marketing metrics: CAC, ROAS, LTV, retention, incrementality, and attribution
  • Direct experience building campaigns on platforms such as Apple Search Ads, Meta (Facebook/Instagram), Google App Campaigns, or similar
  • Strong written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to adjust your style based on your audience
  • Comfort working in a fast-paced, client-focused, remote environment
  • Strong ownership, follow-through, and attention to detail

We'd Be Delighted If You Also Have

  • Experience with App Store Optimization, app store analytics, or mobile conversion optimization
  • Experience working with enterprise clients or in agency-style client engagements
  • Familiarity with Gummicube's tools, the App Store, Google Play, or app store creative testing and conversion optimization
  • Experience analyzing complex issues and developing realistic plans, programs, and recommendations for diverse stakeholders
  • Comfort presenting to C-level stakeholders and connecting marketing activities to broader business objectives
  • Experience experimenting with AI tools in your personal or professional life - or an eagerness to learn

Work Location & Travel Requirements

Airship’s ‘Digital First’ approach to work means that for the majority of our roles, work can be performed remotely, either some or most of the time. Airship believes that flexible work contributes to a more productive and more equitable work environment, and that Airshippers are able to collaborate, innovate, and support one another across different locations and timezones.

Some roles may require that employees perform their work from a specific location to support business activities, and/or be within proximity to an Airship office location or customer or partner locations, while other roles can be performed 100% remotely.

This position is fully remote and may require up to 10% travel based on business needs or as requested by your manager.

Compensation

Starting Pay Range: $130,000-$145,000 USD per year

This is a good faith estimate of the base compensation we reasonably expect to pay for this position upon hire. Actual starting pay may vary based on factors such as relevant skills, work experience, market demands, and location. All offers include stock options so employees have the opportunity to benefit from Airship’s success.

Benefits & Perks

  • Competitive medical, dental, and vision insurance options for you and your dependents
  • Flexible time off, company paid holidays, paid parental leave, and paid volunteer time off
  • Support for your overall wellbeing with mental health and wellness resources
  • Employer-subsidized life insurance as well as short-term and long-term disability
  • A digital-first work environment and a monthly stipend to support remote work
  • Mentorship and growth opportunities to build skills and accelerate professional development
  • And more!

We use artificial intelligence tools in our recruitment process as decision-support tools only. Airship's People Operations team reviews all AI-generated scores and recommendations before making any hiring determination. No applicant is rejected solely on the basis of an AI-generated output. Depending on your location, you may have the right to request human review of any AI-assisted employment decision or to opt out of AI evaluation. To make a request or learn more about how we use AI in hiring, contact or visit .

California residents can view the CCPA disclosure notice here.

**Please Note: To ensure the security of your personal information, Airship will only contact candidates through email addresses ending with “@airship.com”.

Hiring Commitment

Airship is committed to fostering a diverse work environment and providing equal employment opportunities to all applicants and employees. We welcome your application and our hiring and employment decisions are made irrespective of race, religion, color, national origin, gender, gender expression, sexual orientation, age, marital status, veteran status, disability status or any other characteristic protected by law. In alignment with our commitment to equal opportunity, Airship will consider for employment all qualified applicants, including those with criminal histories, in a way that adheres to the principles of fairness and the requirements of local Fair Chance laws, where applicable.

By submitting this application, I affirm that the facts set forth in it are true and complete to the best of my knowledge. I understand that if I am employed, false statements, omissions, or misleading information given in my application, interview(s), or in a background check may result in dismissal.
