Who We Are: At Hunt St, we help Australian companies hire top remote talent in the Philippines. For this role, you will be engaged directly by the client as an independent contractor. We are not an outsourcing agency. All of our roles are 100% remote so you'll be able to work from home.

Who The Client Is: This construction-led design consultancy firm specializes in delivering innovative design solutions and expert advice for fit-outs, refurbishments, and new construction projects. With a unique approach, the company combines expert coordination and offers additional services that exceed the typical scope of traditional design consulting.

Role Overview: The Senior AutoCAD 2D Design Drafter is responsible for preparing, coordinating, and managing high-quality mechanical services drawings and documentation using AutoCAD. This role provides drafting and technical support to engineers during the design and documentation stages of projects, ensuring drawings are accurate, efficient, and compliant with project requirements and standards.

The role requires a strong understanding of building services design, particularly mechanical HVAC systems, and the ability to interpret engineering concepts and translate them into coordinated construction documentation.

Key Responsibilities:

Drafting and Documentation

  • Prepare detailed 2D AutoCAD drawings for mechanical services, including air conditioning, ventilation, exhaust systems, plant rooms, and ductwork layouts.
  • Produce drawings for concept design, design development, and tender documentation stages.
  • Prepare mechanical layouts, schematics, equipment schedules, and detail drawings based on engineering direction.
  • Update and revise drawings in response to design changes, mark-ups, and coordination feedback.
  • Ensure drawings comply with drafting standards, project requirements, and relevant codes.

Engineering Support

  • Provide drafting support to mechanical engineers during design and coordination processes.
  • Assist engineers in preparing design documentation packages and tender drawings.
  • Convert design sketches, engineering calculations, and mark-ups into clear and accurate drawings.
  • Prepare equipment schedules, legends, and drawing registers.
  • Support engineers with drawing coordination across architectural, structural, electrical, and hydraulic services.

Quality Control

  • Conduct internal drafting reviews to ensure drawings are accurate, coordinated, and ready for issue.
  • Ensure documentation is consistent across the drawing set and aligns with project standards.
  • Identify potential design or coordination issues and escalate them to engineers as required.

Requirements

Essential

  • Minimum 5 years’ experience in AutoCAD drafting within building services and mechanical HVAC engineering design.
  • Strong proficiency in 2D AutoCAD drafting.
  • Strong Hands-on experience with Revit or BIM coordination.
  • Solid understanding of mechanical building services systems, including ductwork, plant layouts, ventilation systems, and equipment coordination.
  • Ability to read and interpret engineering mark-ups, sketches, and specifications.
  • Strong attention to detail and ability to produce high-quality technical drawings.
  • Ability to manage multiple projects and meet deadlines.

Desirable

  • Experience working within engineering consultancies or mechanical contracting environments.
  • Understanding of relevant Australian Standards for mechanical services (e.g., AS1668).
  • Experience preparing tender and construction documentation.

Personal Attributes

  • Highly organised with strong attention to detail.
  • Strong communication and teamwork skills.
  • Proactive approach to problem solving and coordination.
  • Ability to work independently while supporting engineers and project teams.

Key Outcomes

  • Production of accurate and coordinated mechanical services drawings.
  • Efficient support to engineers during project delivery.
  • High-quality documentation delivered on time and in accordance with project standards.

Work Arrangement & Expectations:

This is a remote role that will be set up as an independent contractor engagement.

To ensure alignment and transparency, successful candidates will be expected to:

  • Disclose any existing ongoing roles or client work
  • Reflect this engagement on their LinkedIn profile (clearly marked as “Independent Contractor”)

Introductie

Wil jij als SAP Supply Chain Consultant niet alleen werken met de nieuwste technologieën, maar ook bijdragen aan de processen van toonaangevende bedrijven in Nederland? Denk aan klanten in de high-tech, logistiek en maakindustrie die vertrouwen op jouw expertise voor hun logistieke succes. SUPERP is een IT-consultancy partner die sinds 1999 het digitale hart van toonaangevende organisaties versterkt. Met meer dan 500 consultants bouwen we aan betrouwbare, toekomstbestendige Digital Core-systemen. We combineren de slagkracht van een grote speler met de betrokkenheid van een specialist. raw.excerpt: Our PurposeAt SentinelOne, we are driven by a clear purpose: to give the advantage to those who secure our future.
raw.description:
Our Purpose

At SentinelOne, we are driven by a clear purpose: to give the advantage to those who secure our future. As AI reshapes how organizations build, operate, and innovate, the responsibility to protect them becomes more critical than ever. When you join SentinelOne, your work helps protect global enterprises, critical infrastructure, and the technologies shaping tomorrow. If you are motivated by meaningful challenges and want your impact to be real, measurable, and global, you will find purpose here.

About Us

SentinelOne is a company at the intersection of AI and security, pioneering a new operating model for cybersecurity. Our AI-native platform unifies protection across endpoint, cloud, identity, data, and AI systems to deliver autonomous detection and response with clarity and speed. By combining real-time analytics, intelligent automation, and a unified data foundation, we reduce noise, simplify complexity, and empower security teams to focus on what truly matters.

Our teams are builders, problem-solvers, and innovators committed to shaping the future of security. If you are excited to solve hard problems alongside talented, mission-driven people, we invite you to help us build a safer future for humanity.

What Are We Looking For?

We’re looking for people who are relentlessly curious and committed to continuous learning. AI is reshaping every function across our business, and we enable every team member, regardless of role or level, to build fluency in AI tools and concepts. Those who thrive here actively seek out new solutions, experiment thoughtfully, and apply what they learn to drive better, faster, smarter outcomes.

As a Competitive Intelligence Specialist you will operate at the intersection of AI-powered workflows, strategic research, and sales enablement. This is not a traditional CI role. We are building something different: a program where intelligence is systematically generated, continuously updated, and deeply embedded into how our go-to-market teams sell and compete every day.

Reporting to the Senior Director of Market Intelligence, you will own and evolve our Win/Loss program, build AI-assisted research and analysis workflows using Claude and other tools, and serve as a key resource for Sales and Marketing as they navigate competitive situations. You are organized, relentlessly curious, and driven by a high bar for execution quality. You thrive when managing multiple workstreams simultaneously and take pride in delivering outputs that are both rigorous and immediately usable.

The CI function at SentinelOne is at an inflection point. We are investing in AI-native workflows, expanding into analyst relations, and building a program infrastructure that does not yet exist in full. This role has real scope to shape how competitive intelligence works here, not just execute against a predefined playbook. If you want ownership, a team that takes the work seriously, and the latitude to build, this is the role.

What Will You Do?

Primary responsibilities include:

  • Manage our Win/Loss program in partnership with a third-party interview vendor, owning the overall program cadence, scope, and quality of deal coverage across Endpoint, Identity, and MDR segments.
  • Analyze and synthesize interview findings from the vendor into clear competitive themes, patterns, and deal-level insights, going beyond data delivery to surface the "so what" for the business.
  • Translate Win/Loss themes into sales plays in close partnership with the Sales Enablement team, ensuring insights drive concrete changes in how sellers handle objections, position against competitors, and navigate common deal scenarios.
  • Deliver regular Win/Loss reporting to Sales leadership, Product, and Marketing, with clear trend analysis and competitive exposure signals that inform both tactical and strategic decisions.
  • Build and maintain AI-assisted research and analysis workflows using Claude and other tools, reducing the manual lift of competitive monitoring and insight generation.
  • Develop reusable prompt frameworks for tasks such as competitor webpage differentiation analysis, product announcement summarization, and battlecard content generation.
  • Document and iterate on workflow templates so that CI outputs are scalable, repeatable, and available to cross-functional teams without requiring significant analyst time.
  • Stay current on AI tooling relevant to competitive intelligence and proactively surface workflow improvements to the team.
  • Own battlecard development as a core deliverable, maintaining a library that is current, accurate, and structured for how sellers actually use them in the field. This includes knowing when to update, when to rebuild, and how to translate positioning into language that lands in a live conversation.
  • Act as a real-time competitive resource for Sales and Sales Engineering during active deals, providing fast, high-quality analysis on demand.
  • Deliver competitive training and enablement sessions, keeping field teams sharp on the evolving landscape.
  • Serve as the human in the loop for AI-assisted content development. You will use Claude and other tools to accelerate first drafts, research synthesis, and content updates, but you own the editorial judgment: what goes in, what gets cut, and whether the output is actually ready for the field.
  • Monitor the competitive landscape across key vendors, tracking product releases, pricing shifts, messaging changes, and go-to-market movements.
  • Synthesize signals from multiple sources, including analyst reports, earnings calls, social channels, customer conversations, and industry events, into clear, prioritized intelligence.
  • Contribute to and maintain a centralized intelligence repository that is accurate, accessible, and structured for reuse.
  • Partner with Product Marketing to align competitive positioning with broader messaging and campaigns.
  • Collaborate with Product Management to surface competitive gaps and inform roadmap conversations.
  • Work across Marketing, Channel, and Partner teams to ensure competitive intelligence is embedded in external-facing programs where applicable.

What Skills and Knowledge Will You Bring?

Ideal candidates will have:

  • 2+ years of experience in competitive intelligence, product marketing, strategy, or a related field, preferably within cybersecurity or enterprise SaaS.
  • Experience with or genuine interest in building a Win/Loss program. You do not need to have owned one before, but you should be able to articulate how you would approach turning raw interview data into field-ready sales plays.
  • Hands-on experience using AI tools (Claude, ChatGPT, Gemini, or similar) to accelerate research, synthesize information, and create structured outputs. You are not intimidated by prompt engineering and have a point of view on how to use these tools well.
  • Strong project management skills. You can run multiple concurrent workstreams, maintain quality, and consistently hit deadlines without sacrificing depth.
  • Exceptional written communication skills. Your deliverables are clear, concise, and structured for the audience. You know the difference between a Slack message, a battlecard, and a leadership briefing.
  • A natural sense of curiosity. You notice things others miss, ask the second and third follow-up question, and treat competitive intelligence as a discipline, not a task list.
  • Ability to work cross-functionally and earn trust with Sales, Product, and Marketing stakeholders through the quality of your work and responsiveness.
  • Comfort operating in ambiguity. Not every question has a clean answer. You know how to frame incomplete information clearly and flag what is known versus inferred.
  • Familiarity with cybersecurity concepts (EDR, XDR, MDR, identity security) is a plus, but not required. An aptitude to learn the domain quickly is required.
  • Bachelor's degree in a relevant field, or equivalent professional experience.

Why SentinelOne?

AI is redefining how the world operates and rewriting the rules of security in real time, and SentinelOne was built for this moment. From day one, we architected an AI-native platform designed to operate at machine speed, not as an add-on to legacy systems but as the foundation itself. If you want to build where innovation and impact move together, this is that place.

We invest in our Sentinels with comprehensive, competitive benefits designed to support you and your family:

Equity & Rewards

  • Restricted Stock Units (RSUs)
  • Employee Stock Purchase Plan (ESPP)

Time Off & Wellbeing

  • Flexible time off
  • Paid company holidays and paid sick time
  • Gender-neutral parental leave
  • Grandparent leave

Insurance & Financial Security

  • Medical, dental, and vision coverage
  • 401(k) retirement plan with company match
  • Life and disability insurance
  • Health and dependent care FSA
  • Voluntary benefits (hospital, accident, critical illness)
  • Employee Assistance Program (EAP)
  • ARAG pre-paid legal
  • Nationwide pet insurance
  • Cancer Care program
  • Global business travel medical insurance

Work Perks & Flexibility

  • Home office allowance
  • Mobile phone reimbursement

Wellness & Lifestyle

  • Wellness coach
  • Wellness/gym reimbursement
  • Fertility coverage
  • Adoption & surrogacy reimbursement

This U.S. role has a base pay range that will vary based on the location of the candidate. For some locations, a different pay range may apply. If so, this range will be provided to you during the recruiting process. You can also reach out to the recruiter with any questions.

Amazon Inventory Planner

SUMMARY

The Amazon Inventory Planner is responsible for managing inventory planning, forecasting, and replenishment across Amazon Seller Central and Vendor Central accounts to ensure optimal inventory levels that maximize sales, prevent stockouts, minimize excess inventory, and support overall account profitability. Working closely with the Business Operations Specialist and Inventory team, this role monitors inventory health, analyzes trends, and executes inventory strategies aligned with business objectives. The ideal candidate is a proactive inventory professional with a strong understanding of Amazon's selling platforms, exceptional forecasting and inventory optimization skills, and the ability to balance inventory investment with product availability to drive sales growth and operational efficiency.

DUTIES AND RESPONSIBILITIES:

  • Inventory Management: Manage daily inventory operations across Amazon Seller Central (FBA and FBM) and Vendor Central accounts by monitoring inventory levels to maintain optimal stock availability and prevent stockouts, overstocks, and stranded inventory. Create and manage inventory replenishment plans in collaboration with the Business Operations Specialist using sales forecasts and lead times. Track inventory movement across warehouses, Amazon fulfillment centers, and third-party logistics providers, while coordinating inventory transfers and replenishment shipments to Amazon fulfillment centers.
  • Forecasting & Planning: Analyze historical sales data, seasonality, promotional calendars, and market trends alongside the Business Operations Specialist to forecast product demand. Recommend inventory forecasts and purchasing decisions under the guidance of the Business Operations Specialist and Inventory team. Collaborate with the Inventory and Product teams to ensure products are available when needed and support new product launches through inventory planning and forecasting strategies.
  • Amazon Account Management: Monitor the overall health of Amazon inventory by reviewing key performance metrics, including Inventory Performance Index (IPI), excess and aged inventory, sell-through and in-stock rates, and restock limits. Review Vendor Central purchase orders, coordinate fulfillment requirements, and manage Amazon replenishment reports and restock recommendations. Resolve inventory-related issues such as stranded inventory, suppressed listings, and receiving discrepancies to ensure accurate inventory management and uninterrupted product availability.

Requirements

  • 3+ years of experience in inventory management, supply chain, operations, or Amazon marketplace environments.
  • Hands-on experience with Amazon Seller Central and/or Vendor Central.
  • Experience with inventory forecasting and replenishment planning.
  • Strong analytical, problem-solving, and data analysis skills, with the ability to review large datasets and reports.
  • Advanced proficiency in Microsoft Excel or Google Sheets.
  • Strong attention to detail, organizational skills, and the ability to manage multiple priorities in a fast-paced environment.
  • Ability to work effectively in a remote office environment and coordinate regularly with warehouse and fulfillment partners.
  • Experience with FBA inventory management and Vendor Central forecasting.
  • Knowledge of Amazon inventory performance metrics and policies.
  • Experience with ERP, inventory management, or forecasting software.
  • Familiarity with eCommerce operations, retail distribution, or publishing inventory management.
  • Occasional travel to Exton, PA required.
  • Exemplify and live our core values of humility, passion, and integrity.

Benefits

  • Health Care Plan (Medical, Dental & Vision)
  • Retirement Plan (401k, IRA)
  • Life Insurance (Basic, Voluntary & AD&D)
  • Paid Time Off (Vacation, Sick & Public Holidays)
  • Family Leave (Maternity, Paternity)
  • Short Term & Long Term Disability
  • Training & Development
  • Work From Home
  • Wellness Resources

Make a difference. Be happy. Grow your career.

SENIOR CONSULTANT - STAFFING SERVICES

The Senior Consultant - Staffing Services provides expert platform-specific services leveraging their technical, management, and leadership skills to ensure success and aide their client in meeting their organizational goals.

Key Responsibilities

Perform professional services for Nordic and its affiliates in alignment with the expectations of Nordic and each applicable client, including but not limited to:

  • Evaluate current-system processes and procedures; recommend and develop workflow and computer system configurations and modifications based on experience and best practice
  • Apply technical expertise to individual client system build to identify, test, and troubleshoot software systems
  • Provide project management and project leadership services in alignment with client expectations and contracted role
  • Provide leadership guidance and mentorship to client and Nordic teammates
  • Work directly with project teams, end-users, and leadership as project needs dictate
  • Lead and attend meetings regarding project status and on-going work-product coordination
  • Accurately and completely document work progress, issues, escalations, and other required information in accordance with Nordic and individual client requirements
  • Additional specific duties related to the project as may be required and dictated by client

Skills and Experience

  • Bachelor’s degree or equivalent experience required
  • Relevant training, certification, or accreditation required
  • 2+ years’ relevant industry-specific work experience required
  • 5+ years’ professional experience strongly preferred
  • Previous consulting experience preferred
  • Excellent communication skills, written and verbal
  • Proven ability to apply problem solving and technical skills
  • Must demonstrate and embody Nordic’s maxims
  • Possess a strong work ethic and treat others with respect, keep commitments, inspire the trust of others, work ethically and with integrity, and uphold organizational values
  • Strong attention to detail and ability to manage multiple priorities while meeting customer service commitments and project timelines
  • Demonstrated sound judgment and appropriate escalation
  • Highly organized, able to multi-task as well as maintain intense focus on individual tasks
  • Self-starter with ability to maintain schedule, meet deadlines, and monitor one’s own work product
  • Highly adaptable and able to acclimate quickly to new project assignments
  • Aptitude for mentoring and guiding others
  • Maintain a high degree of professionalism
  • Must be able to work independently, as well as within a team environment

Additional Details

  • Work may be performed remotely or onsite in a professional office environment, healthcare, or other industry-specific facility
  • Travel up to 100% of the time, or as Nordic or client needs dictate
  • Position generally necessitates travel outside of scheduled work hours including nights or weekends; travel interruptions may occur
  • Work schedule will vary based on Nordic or client needs, and may include weekdays, weekends, holidays, after-hours, on-call, or long hours
  • Must be available for calls, emails, and consults regularly and outside of scheduled work hours to support the client and communicate with Nordic staff as necessary
  • Timely entry of time and expenses required in accordance with Nordic and client policy
  • Status reporting and project handoff documentation as required by Nordic or client
  • Provide equipment necessary to perform job functions in accordance with Nordic and client policy
  • Complete all Nordic and client required training and education in timely manner
  • Respond to communication from Nordic management team and other corporate team members in a timely and complete manner
  • May be invited to attend corporate functions as a representative of the company to meet prospective consultants, as well as solidify relationships with client and Nordic co-workers

Nordic is an equal opportunity employer. We are committed to creating an inclusive environment for all employees and applicants. We do not discriminate on the basis of race, color, religion, sex, national origin, age, disability, genetic information, marital or veteran status, or any other protected status under applicable federal, state, or local laws. We encourage individuals of all backgrounds to apply, including women, minorities, individuals with disabilities, and veterans.
